de lta bu'i phan bde skyob pa'i byed pa'ang rtsol ba dang bcas pa ma yin par ngang ngam lhun gyis grub pa dang*/ rang don du theg pa gsum gyi 'bras bu la mngon sum du mi byed pa'i bdag nyid dang*/ byed pa'i tha ma rten gyi mdzad pa ste/ byed pa por bshad pa 'di dang bcas pas ni byed pa'i mtshan nyid bshad pa yin no//drug pa ngo bo nyid mtshan ni/ nyon mongs rtags dang mtshan ma dang*//mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po dag/dben dang dka' dang nges pa dang*//ched du bya dang mi dmigs dang*// 29 mngon par zhen pa bkag pa dang*//dmigs pa zhes bya gang yin dang*//mi mthun thogs pa med dang de//gzhi med 'gro med skye med dang*// 30 de bzhin nyid ni mi dmigs dang*//ngo bo nyid bcu drug bdag nyid*//mtshon bya lta bur mtshon pas na//mtshan nyid bzhi par bzhed pa yin// 31 zhes gsungs te/ nyon mongs pas dben pa dang*/ rtags dang rtags can sogs kyi chos kyi dben pa dang*/ mtshan ma ste dmigs pas dben pa dang*/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs dang*/ spros pa dag gis nye bar dben pa dang*/ spang byas kyang dben na gnyen po dag gis dben pa dang*/ sems can mya ngan las 'da' ba'am/ 'tshang rgya ba'i thabs ston kyang*/ sems can 'tshang rgya ba mi srid pa'i phyir/ lam sgrub pa sogs dka' ba nyid kyis dben pa dang*/ chos kyi dbyings yongs grub rdzogs sangs rgyas kho nar nges pas theg pa gzhan gyi spros pas dben pa dang*/ yongs grub nyid la bzod pa'i phyir ched du bya bas mtshan nyid gzhan gyi g.yeng bas dben pa dang*/ ngo bo nyid mi dmigs pas dmigs pas dben pa dang*/ mngon par zhen pa bkag pa ste rang bzhin gyis dben pa dang*/ don dam pa'i dmigs pa zhes bya ba gang yin pa de kun rdzob kyi dmigs pas dben pa dang*/ de nyid log pa'i 'khrul pa thams cad kyis dben pas mi mthun pa dang*/ mi mthun pa de rang gi ngo bo rdo rjer gsungs pa'i phyir thogs pa med pa dang*/

de bzhin nyid 'di la 'khor ba dang 'khrul pa'i gnas kyi gzhi med pa dang*/ 'gro 'ong med pa dang*/ skye ba ste gsar byung med pa dang*/ de bzhin nyid ni de bzhin nyid las gzhan du mi dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i ngo bo nyid ldog cha bcu drug gi bdag nyid can gyis mtshan gzhi de nyid mtshon pa skabs su bab na'ang*/ 'dir mtshon bya mkhyen gsum gyi shes khyad byed pa lta bur mtshon pas na mtshon par byed pa'i mtshan nyid 'di ni bzhi par bzhed pa yin no//bzhi pa thar pa cha mthun la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ mtshan med rab tu sbyin la sogs//yang dag sgrub la mkhas pa ni//rnam pa thams cad rtogs 'di la//thar pa'i cha dang mthun par 'dod// 32ces gsungs te/ mtshan ma med par rtogs kyang mtshan bcas thabs kyi cha rab tu sbyin pa dang*/ la sogs pas pha rol tu phyin pa gzhan rnams kyang yang dag par phyin ci ma log par sgrub pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'i tshogs lam gyi ngo bo nyid rnam pa brgya bdun cu rtsa gsum po thams cad rim bzhin rtogs pa'i sbyor ba 'di la thar pa'i cha dang mthun par 'dod cing bstan to//gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis/ yul gyi dbye ba dang*/ dbang po'i dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ sangs rgyas sogs dmigs dad pa dang*//sbyin sogs spyod yul brtson 'grus dang*//bsam pa phun tshogs dran pa dang*//rnam par mi rtog ting 'dzin dang*// 33chos rnams rnam pa thams cad du//shes pa'i shes rab dang rnam lnga//zhes gsungs te/ sangs rgyas dang la sogs pas dkon mchog gsum dang*/ don dam pa'i rgyu mchog dang 'bras mchog la dmigs pa'i dad pa phun tshogs dang*/ sbyin pa dang*/ la sogs pas tshul khrims sogs pha rol tu phyin pa rnams la spyod pa'i yul can gyi brtson 'grus phun tshogs dang*/ thos pa'i don ji lta ba bsam pa'i phun tshogs kyi dran pa dang*/ phyi rol gyi rnam par g.yeng ba la mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/

chos rnams kyi rang spyi'i mtshan nyid rnam pa thams cad du shes pa'i shes rab dang rnam pa lnga'o//gnyis pa dbang po'i dbye ba ni/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub rnon po yis//rtogs sla rtul pos rtogs dkar bzhed// 34 ces gsungs te/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par byed pa la'ang dad sogs de dag skye med du rtogs pa'i dbang po rnon po yis ni rtogs par sla la/ mtshan 'dzin dang bcas pa'i dbang po rtul pos ni rtogs dka' bar bzhed do//gnyis pa sbyor ba khyad par can la gsum/ drod rtse bzod mchog sgom pa'i gnas skabs/ gang zag /sgom rim khyad par can no/ /dang po ni/ dro ba rnams kyi dmigs pa 'dir//sems can thams cad yin par bsngags//de dag nyid la sems mnyam sogs//rnam pa dag ni bcur bshad do// 35 bdag nyid sdig pa las ldog cing*//sbyin la sogs la gnas pas gzhan//de dag la ni 'god pa dang*//bsngags pa brjod dang mthun pa nyid// 36 rtser gyur de bzhin bzod pa ni//rang gzhan rten can bden shes pa//chos mchog de bzhin sems can rnams//smin byed sogs kyis shes par bya// 37 zhes gsungs te/ de yang dro ba rnams kyi dmigs pa 'dir/ /zhes pas/ 'dir gyi don skabs dang po gsum du sbyor mthong sgom gsum bstan pa las/ sbyor ba dang po gsum du sbyor mthong sgom gsum ston pa'i skabs 'dir zhes pa yin ces kha cig zer ro/ /des na sems can thams cad skabs 'di'i dmigs yul yin par dmigs par bsngags te/ de la dmigs nas rdzogs byang bsgrub pa'i phyir ro//des na drod sogs re re la'ang chung 'bring chen po'i sgo nas rnam pa rnams bshad par bya ste/ de'ang drod chung ngu 'bring chen po gsum gyi rnam pa ni sems can de dag nyid la dmigs nas sems mnyam nyid du bsgom pa sogs kyis rnam pa dag ni bcur bshad do/ /rtse mo'i dmigs pa ni sngar bzhin las/ rtse mo chung ngu'i rnam pa ni/

bdag nyid sdig pa las ldog cing*//de dag la ni 'god pa dang*//bsngags pa brjod dang mthun pa nyid/ /ces pa'o//rtse mo 'bring gi rnam pa ni/ sbyin la sogs la gnas pas gzhan//de dag la ni 'god pa dang*//bsngags pa brjod dang mthun pa nyid/ /ces pa'o//sogs pas rtse mo chen po'i rnam pa ni/ nang stong sogs la gnas pas gzhan//de dag la ni 'god pa dang*//bsngags pa brjod dang mthun pa nyid//ces pas/ rtse mo chung 'bring chen po gsum gyi rnam pa bstan la/ de bzhin bzod pa'i dmigs pa ni/ snga ma bzhin las/ bzod pa chung ngu'i rnam pa ni/ rang nyid bden bzhi la gnas gzhan//de dag la ni 'god pa dang*//bsngags pa brjod dang mthun pa nyid/ /ces so//bzod pa 'bring gi rnam pa ni/ zhugs sogs ched du gnas pas gzhan//de dag la ni 'god pa dang*//bsngags pa brjod dang mthun pa nyid/ /ces pa'o//bzod pa chen po'i rnam pa ni/ byang sems skyon med la gnas gzhan//de dag la ni 'god pa dang*//bsngags pa brjod dang mthun pa nyid/ /ces so//chos mchog gi dmigs pa ni/ snga ma de bzhin las/ chos mchog chung ngu'i rnam pa ni/ sems can rnams yongs su smin par byed pa sogs kyis mtshon pa ste/ sems can smin sogs gnas pas gzhan//de dag la ni 'god pa dang*//bsngags pa brjod dang mthun pa nyid/ /ces so//chos mchog 'bring gi rnam pa ni/ bdag nyid mngon shes bskyed la gnas//de dag la ni 'god pa dang*//bsngags pa brjod dang mthun pa nyid/ /ces so//chos mchog chen po'i rnam pa ni/ bdag nyid rnam mkhyen bskyed la gnas//de dag la ni 'god pa dang*//bsngags pa brjod dang mthun pa nyid//ces par sbyar te shes par bya'o//gnyis pa rten gyi gang zag phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags la gsum ste/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad dang*/ don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ nges 'byed yan lag nas bzung ste//mthong dang goms pa'i lam dag la//byang chub sems dpa' gang dag gnas//de 'dir phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs//

38 zhes gsungs te/ rten gyi dbye ba'i sgo nas mdor bstan par mdzad de/ de yang nges 'byed kyi yan lag la gnas pa nas bzung ste/ mthong ba dang*/ mthong zin goms pa'i lam dag la byang chub sems dpa' gang dag gnas pa de ni skabs 'dir bstan gyi phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs yin te/ lam gsum po de la gnas pa la phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags dang ldan pa'i phyir ro//gnyis pa rgyas bshad la gsum/ sbyor lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags nyi shu/ mthong lam la phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags bcu drug /sgom lam gyi phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags so/ /dang po la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o//dang po ni/gzugs la sogs las ldog sogs rtags//rnam pa nyi shur brjod pa yis//nges 'byed yan lag la gnas pa'i//phyir mi ldog pa'i mtshan nyid 'di// 39 zhes gsungs te/ gzugs la sogs pa la gzugs sogs su bzung ba las ldog pa la sogs pa'i rtags kyi rnam pa nyi shur brjod pa yis nges 'byed kyi lam gyi yan lag la gnas pa'i phyir mi ldog pa'i mtshan nyid du 'di bstan to//gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la bzhi/ drod kyi rtags bcu gcig /rtse mo'i rtags drug /bzod pa'i rtags gnyis/ chos mchog gi rtags gcig go /dang po ni/gzugs la sogs las ldog pa dang*//the tshom mi dal zad pa dang*//bdag nyid dge ba la gnas shing*//gzhan dag de la 'god pa dang*// 40 gzhan gyi rten can sbyin sogs dang*//zab mo'i don la'ang som nyi med//byams lus sogs dang sgrib pa ni//rnam pa lnga dang mi 'grogs dang*// 41 bag la nyal kun 'joms pa dang*//dran pa dang ni shes bzhin dang*//gos la sogs pa gtsang ba dang*//zhes gsungs te/ gzugs la sogs pa'i chos la de dang der mos pa ldog pa dang*/ yang dag pa'i don la don ma yin du 'dzin pa'i the tshom zad pa dang*/ mi dal ba ste mi khoms pa'i gnas su skye ba zad pa dang*/ bdag nyid dge ba 'ba' zhig la gnas shing gzhan dag dge ba de la 'god pa dang*/

'god par gyur pa'i gdul bya gzhan gyi rten can des kyang gzhan sbyin sogs la 'god pa dang*/ zab mo'i don la'ang som nyi med pa dang*/ bya ba byams pa dang 'brel ba'i lus dang*/ sogs pas ngag yid kyis gzhan la phan par byed pa nyid dang*/ 'dod 'dun sogs sgrib pa ni rnam pa lnga dang mi 'grogs pa dang*/ lta ba'i bag la nyal kun tu 'joms pa dang*/ 'das pa'i yul la dran pa ldan pa dang ni/ da ltar gyi yul la shes bzhin dang ldan pa dang*/ gos la sogs pa'i yo byad kha na ma tho ba med pas gtsang ba dang bcu gcig go/gnyis pa rtse mo'i rtags drug ni/ lus la srin bu rnams mi 'byung*// 42 gya gyu med sems sbyangs pa dang*//len dang ser sna med sogs dang*//chos nyid ldan par 'gro nyid dang*//sems can don du dmyal 'tshol dang*// 43 zhes gsungs te/ lus la srin bu rnams mi 'byung ba dang*/ dman pa yid byed kyi gya gyu med pa'i sems dang*/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi gnas ngan len yongs su sbyong ba'i spyod pa len pa dang*/ ser sna med pa dang*/ sogs pas phyin drug gi mi mthun phyogs med pa dang*/ chos nyid dang mi 'gal bar ldan par byang chub tu 'gro ba nyid dang*/ sems can gyi don du dmyal ba'ang 'tshol ba ste drug go/ gsum pa bzod pa'i rtags gnyis ni/ gzhan gyis dkri bar mi btub dang*//lam gzhan nye bar ston bdud la//bdud ces bya bar rtogs pa dang*//zhes gsungs te/ ston pa dang lam gzhan gyis dkri bar mi btub pa dang*/ theg chen gyi lam ma yin pa'i lam gzhan nye bar ston pa'i bdud dam gnod pa la gnod pa'am/ gegs sam/ gdon nam/ bdud ces bya bar rtogs pa dang gnyis so//bzhi pa chos mchog gi rtags gcig ni/ sangs rgyas dgyes pa'i spyod pa ste// 44 rtags ni nyi shu de dag gis//drod dang rtse mo bzod bcas dang*//chos mchog rnams la gnas pa ni//rdzogs pa'i byang chub las mi ldog/ 45 ces gsungs te/

sangs rgyas dgyes pa'i spyod pa la bslab pa ste/ mdor na rtags ni nyi shu po de dag gis drod dang rtse mo bzod pa dang bcas pa dang*/ chos mchog rnams la gnas pa'i sbyor lam pa ni rdzogs pa'i byang chub las gnas skabs gzhan pa'i byang chub tu phyir mi ldog go/gnyis pa mthong lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mthong ba'i lam la bzod pa dang*//shes pa'i skad cig bcu drug ni//byang chub sems dpa' mi ldog pa'i//mtshan nyid yin par shes par bya// 46 zhes gsungs te/ de'ang theg chen gyi mthong ba'i lam la bzod pa brgyad dang*/ shes pa brgyad kyi skad cig ma bcu drug ni byang chub sems dpa' mthong ba'i lam las phyir mi ldog pa'i mtshan nyid yin par shes par bya'o//gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis/ dbye ba dang*/ don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ sdug bden gyi rnam pa/ kun bden gyi rnam pa/ 'gog bden gyi rnam pa/ lam bden gyi rnam pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gzugs sogs 'du shes ldog pa dang*//sems brtan theg pa dman dag las//rnam ldog bsam gtan la sogs pa'i//yan lag yongs su zad pa dang*// 47 zhes gsungs te/ gzugs dang la sogs pas phung sogs kyi chos la mtshan 'dzin gyi 'du shes las ldog pa sdug bsngal la chos shes pa'i bzod pa dang*/ bdud las kyis byang chub tu sems bskyed pa las bzlog kyang bzlog tu mi btub pa'i sems brtan pa de sdug bsngal la chos shes pa dang*/ theg pa dman pa dag las sems rnam par log pa ni sdug bsngal rjes su shes pa'i bzod pa dang*/ bsam gtan bzhi dang*/ gzugs med pa bzhi dang*/ 'gog pa la snyoms par 'jug kyang bsam gtan la sogs pa'i dbang gis skye ba len pa'i yan lag ste rgyu yongs su zad pa ni sdug bsngal la rjes su shes pa'o//gnyis pa kun bden gyi rnam pa ni/ lus sems yang ba nyid dang ni//'dod pa spyod la thabs mkhas dang*//rtag tu tshangs par spyod nyid dang*//'tsho ba rnam par dag nyid dang*//

48 zhes gsungs te/ lus dang sems gang du skyo ba dang 'jug pa la yang ba nyid dang ldan pa ni kun 'byung la chos shes pa'i bzod pa dang*/ sbyin pa gtong ba dang*/ zang zing gi sgo nas chags can gyi gdul bya 'khor du bsdu ba'i phyir 'dod pa'i yon tan la lus ngag gis nye bar spyod kyang*/ sems kyis yul la 'dun pa dang bcas pa'i rgyu ba gtan nas chad pas thabs la mkhas pa zhes bya ste/ de'ang rang nyid 'dod yon la dug ltar gzigs kyang 'dod yon sman ltar bsten pa'i tshul bstan nas/ gzhan dag 'dod yon gyi rgyus gdul bya bkri ste/ mthar thug gdul bya 'dod yon la dug ltar blta ba'i thabs ston pas rang gzhan 'khor ba'i nyes pas mi gos par byed pa ni kun 'byung la chos shes dang*/ thabs mkhas pa'i spyod pas 'dod yon bsten pa ltar snang yang*/ sems dpa' rang nyid kyis 'dod pa'i yon tan 'gar yang ma gzigs pas rtag tu tshangs par spyod pa nyid la gnas pa ni kun 'byung la rjes su shes pa'i bzod pa dang*/ sems dpa' de'i yon tan la gzhan gyis dad pas yon phul ba'i dge rtsa 'phel bar byed cing*/ de la brten nas rang gzhan gyi rgyud kyi sgrib pa yongs su sbyong bar byed nus pas 'tsho ba la kha na ma tho ba rnam par dag pa nyid dang ni kun 'byung la rjes su shes pa'o//gsum pa 'gog bden gyi rnam pa ni/ phung sogs bar chad byed rnams dang*//tshogs dang dbang sogs bcas pa yi//g.yul 'gyed ces gsungs te/ phung po dang sogs pas khams dang skye mched la sbyor ba dang*/ rjes su sbyor ba'i gnas pa so sor bkag pa ni 'gog pa la chos shes pa'i bzod pa dang*/ mngon par rtogs pa la bar chad byed pa'i chos rnams la sbyor ba dang*/ rjes su sbyor ba'i gnas pa so sor bkag pa ni 'gog pa la chos shes pa dang*/ byang chub kyi rgyu tshogs gnyis la dmigs pa dang bcas par sbyor ba dang*/

rjes su sbyor ba'i gnas pa so sor bkag pa ni 'gog pa la rjes su shes pa'i bzod pa dang*/ kun nas nyon mongs pa'i dbang po dang sogs pas shes pa dang*/ de'i yul dang bcas pa'i g.yul 'gyed kyi gtam sogs la sbyor ba dang rjes su sbyor ba'i gnas pa so sor bkag pa ni 'gog pa la rjes su shes pa'o//'dir sbyor ba ni dang po'i zhen blo skad cig ma dang*/ rjes su sbyor ba ni skad cig ma de dran cing yongs su bcad nas shes pa'i zhen pa ste/ gnas pa ni zhen pa'i rang ngo nas bzhag la/ so sor bkag pa ni zhen pa rang gi ngo bo dang*/ ji ltar zhen pa'i tshul so sor bkag pa yin no//bzhi pa lam bden gyi rnam pa ni/ ser sna la sogs la//sbyor dang rjes su sbyor ba yi// 49 gnas pa so sor bkag pa dang*//chos ni rdul tsam mi dmigs nyid//rang gi sa la nges pa nyid//sa gsum la ni gnas pa dang*// 50 chos kyi don du srog gtong ba//zhes gsungs te/ ser sna la sogs la sbyor ba dang rjes su sbyor ba'i gnas pa so sor bkag pa ni lam la chos shes pa'i bzod pa dang*/ chos ni rdul tsam yang mi dmigs pa nyid lam la chos shes pa dang*/ sems dpa' des rang gi sa dang po thob pa la thob par nges pa nyid kyi mkhyen gsum gyi bdag nyid dam/ bar chad med pa'i lam/ rnam grol gyi lam/ khyad par gyi lam du gyur pa'i sa gsum la gnas pa nyid lam rjes su shes pa'i bzod pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos kyi don du srog gtong ba ni lam la rjes su shes pa'o/ /gnyis pa bsdu ba ni/ de 'dra'i skad cig bcu drug ni//blo ldan mthong ba'i lam gnas kyi//phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags dag yin// 51 zhes gsungs te/ bshad pa de 'dra'i skad cig ma bcu drug ni/ byang chub kyi blo dang ldan pa mthong ba'i lam la gnas pa rnams kyi phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags dag yin no//gsum pa sgom lam gyi phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags la brgyad/

sgom lam gyi khyad par/ khyad par gyi gzhi/ dbye ba/ grangs med par bstan pa dang mi 'gal ba/ sgom lam gyi byed pa/ 'bras bu la rtsod pa dgod pa/ lan dpe dang bcas pa/ zab mo brgyad kyi rtags nyid bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bsgom pa'i lam ni zab pa ste//zab mo stong pa nyid la sogs//zab pa de ni sgro 'dogs dang*//skur ba'i mtha' las grol ba nyid// 52 ces gsungs te/ sgom pa'i lam gyi ngo bo ni zab pa yin te/ spangs pa'i rim pa dang*/ rtogs pa'i rim pas rgyud la mngon par rtogs pa 'char ba la sangs rgyas kyi lam zhes bsnyad la/ mngon par rtogs bya chos nyid zab mo la yod ma myong gi dri ma bsal ba ltar/ snang bas chos nyid slar dag par song ba ltar gyur pa la bsams nas 'dus byas kyi chos nyid ces sogs mkhas pa dag gis gsungs so/ /de lta bu'i chos nyid zab mo stong pa nyid dang la sogs pas/ nyi khri snang ba las/ rnam thar sgo gsum 'du mi byed//skyes pa med dang 'dod chags bral//'gog pa zhi ba de bzhin nyid//yang dag mtha' ste zab mo bcu//zhes 'byung ba dang*/ zab pa de ni sgro 'dogs dang skur ba'i mtha' las grol ba nyid yin no/ /zab pa ni rtogs par dka' ba'i don dang*/ rtogs par dka' ba yang rnam shes kyi yul ma yin pa la dgongs pa ste/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par shes par sgro 'dogs pa dang*/ chos dbyings 'phags pa rnams kyi bzhed don sgrub pa'i byed pa rtag pa la skur ba btab pa ste/ de ni sgro 'dogs pa dang*/ skur ba nyid yin no//gnyis pa khyad par gyi gzhi ni/ nges 'byed yan lag dang mthong ba'i//lam dang sgom pa'i lam nyid la//yang dang yang du sems pa dang*//'jal dang nges rtog bsgom pa'i lam// 53 zhes gsungs te/ theg chen gyi nges 'byed yan lag dang*/ mthong ba'i lam dang*/ sgom pa'i lam nyid la rim bzhin sbyor ba'i lam gyi dus su zab mo'i don la yang dang yang du sems pa dang mthong lam gyi dus su mngon du 'jal ba dang*/

sgom lam gyi dus su nges par rtog pa ste/ sems 'jal nges par rtog par bya rgyu'i zab mo de nyid la mnyam par bzhag nas lam sgrub pa ni sgom pa'i lam mo//gsum pa dbye ba ni/ de ni rgyun chags yin pa'i phyir//chung dang 'bring dang chen po rnams//chung ngu'i chung sogs dbye ba yis//rnam pas rnam pa dgur bzhed do// 54 zhes gsungs te/ sgom pa'i lam de ni dang por sems/ bar du 'jal/ tha mar rtog par byed pa'i tshul gyis rgyun chags pa can yin pa'i phyir te/ rgyun de nyid la chung ngu dang*/ 'bring dang chen po gsum du phye ba rnams kyang*/ chung ngu'i chung ngu dang*/ chung ngu'i 'bring dang*/ chung ngu'i chen po la sogs pa re re'ang gsum gsum du dbye ba'i rnam pas sgom lam rnam pa dgur bcom ldan 'das bzhed do//bzhi pa grangs med par bstan pa la mi 'gal bar 'chad pa ni/ grangs med la sogs bstan pa rnams//dam pa'i don du bzod ma yin//kun rdzob tu ni thugs brtse ba'i//rgyu mthun de dag thub pa bzhed// 55 ces gsungs te/ sgom lam re re la 'bras bu bsod nams grangs med la sogs 'byung bar bstan pa rnams dam pa'i don du grangs med la sogs don rang mtshan du bzod pa ma yin te/ grangs med sogs kyang stong nyid kyi rang bzhin las gzhan ma yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ don dam par grangs med sogs stong nyid las gzhan du bzod pa ma yin kyang*/ kun rdzob tu ni bcom ldan 'das kyis sems can la thugs brtse bas sgom lam dgu po dag rgyu mthun pa'i re re zhing 'bras bu grangs med sogs nyer bdun po de dag 'byung bar thub pa'i dbang po bzhed do//lnga pa sgom lam gyi byed pa la gnyis/ brgal ba dang*/ lan no/ /dang po ni/ dngos po brjod du med pa la//nyams pa dang ni 'phel mi rung*//sgom zhes bya ba'i lam gyis ni//ci zhig nyams shing ci zhig thob// 56 ces gsungs te/ sgom lam gyi dngos po brjod bya rjod byed nyid du ma grub pa'am med pa la spang bya nyams pa dang ni gnyen po 'phel du mi rung bas/

sgom pa zhes bya ba'i lam gyi gnas skabs 'dir ni spang bya ci zhig nyams shing gnyen po ci zhig thob ste mi thob par thal lo//gnyis pa lan ni/ byang chub ji lta de bzhin du//'di ni 'dod pa'i don sgrub byed//byang chub de bzhin nyid mtshan nyid//de yang de yi mtshan nyid bzhed// 57 ces gsungs te/ byang chub chen po de brjod du med pa dang*/ 'phel 'grib med kyang gzhan don byed pa ji lta ba de bzhin du sgom lam 'di ni zab mo'i chos nyid yin kyang*/ spang bya spong ba sogs sangs rgyas 'dod pa'i don sgrub par byed pas sgom lam chos nyid yin kyang bya ba mi byed pa min par grub bo//des na thal 'gyur la rkang pa dang po gnyis kyis kun rdzob tu khyab pa ma nges pa'i lan btab pa yin no/ /don dam par ni rkang pa tha ma gnyis kyis 'dod lan bstan pa yin te/ byang chub de de bzhin nyid kyi mtshan nyid yin pa bzhin du/ sgom lam de'ang de bzhin nyid de'i mtshan nyid can du bzhed pas/ sgom lam byed pa med par 'dod pa kho na'o//drug pa 'bras bu la rtsod pa dgod pa ni/ sems ni snga mas byang chub par//rigs min phyi mas kyang ma yin//

zhes gsungs te/ sgom lam gyi sems ni chos can/ byang chub chen po skyed par byed pa'i thabs ma yin par thal/ sems ni snga mas kyang byang chub skyed par byed pa'i thabs kyi rigs pa min la/ sems phyi mas kyang byang chub par byed pa'i thabs ni min pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ sems snga mas kyang byang chub pa'i thabs ma yin te/ sems snga ma de sems phyi ma dang ma 'phrad pa'i phyir te/ sems snga ma yod pa'i tshe phyi ma ma skyes nas med pa'i phyir/ sems phyi mas kyang byang chub pa ma yin te/ sems snga ma de phyi ma dang ma 'phrad pa'i phyir te/ sems phyi ma skyes pa'i tshe snga ma 'gags nas med pa'i phyir ro//bdun pa lan dpe dang bcas pa ni/ mar me'i dpe yi tshul gyis ni//zab mo'i chos nyid rnam pa brgyad// 58 ces gsungs te/ mar me'i skad cig snga phyi 'tshogs nas sdong bu bsregs pa'i dpe'i tshul gyis ni sgom lam phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags zab mo'i chos nyid rnam pa brgyad skad cig snga phyi rim bzhin 'byung ba la bltos nas byang chub thob par byed pa'i thabs su gsungs so//brgyad pa zab mo brgyad kyi rtags nyid bstan pa ni/ skye ba dang ni 'gag pa dang*//de bzhin nyid dang shes bya dang*//shes dang spyod dang gnyis med dang*//thabs mkhas pa la zab pa nyid// 59 ces gsungs te/ kun rdzob kyi skye ba brtags na ma skyes pa dang*/ ma skyes pa de kun rdzob rang la bltos pa'i don dam dang*/ 'di don dam go chod du 'dod pa ngo bo nyid med smra ba dag yin cing*/ de rnam grangs pa'i don dam par dbu ma pa chen po dag bzhed la/ don dam pa'i snying po spros bral du skyes pa ni brtags dpyad kyi blo la don spyi sel ba tsam yang snang mi rung zhing*/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir de lta bu'i skye ba de rtag mi rtag yod med sogs kyi mtha' min pas skye ba zab pa dang ni/ kun rdzob tu ni 'khrul ngor chos dag snang ba la 'khrul tshul ma skyes pa gang zhig skyes par 'khrul pa dang*/

de ltar 'khrul pas ma skyes pa'i stobs kyi skye ba brdzun pa de skyes par ma brtags pas yang 'khrul te 'gag par snang ba dang*/ yang 'khrul rgyun gyis 'gags pa de slar gdod skyes byung snyam pa sogs ma rig pa'i bslad pa bzhugs pa rnams la 'byung gi /don dam par na kun rdzob pa'i chos thams cad ni skye mi srid pa'i phyir 'gag rgyu mi srid la/ don dam mchog gi rang bzhin 'gyur ba med par gnas pas 'gag pa dang rgyun chad pa med pas 'gag pa zab pa dang*/ bden pa gnyis kyi de bzhin nyid tha dad cing gnyis ka la'ang dngos stobs kyi bya byed las gsum re yod la/ bya byed kyi tshul go chod po yin min bden brdzun gyis 'byed cing*/ 'on te de bzhin nyid gnyis ka'ang stong nyid tsam du ris mthun pas de bzhin nyid zab pa dang*/ kun rdzob tu shes par bya ba kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad tshad med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnam shes kyis shes par bya ba gzhal du med pa dang*/ don dam pa'i chos nyid tshad med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa ye shes kyis shes par bya ba'i yul tshad kyis gzhal ba las 'das kyang*/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni bden pa gnyis ka'i shes bya kun mngon par khong du chub pas shes bya zab pa dang*/ rnam shes ni ma rig pa'i rkyen gyi mthus snang ba res 'ga' ba yin cing*/ ye shes ni rkyen gyis khyad par du byar med pa rtag pa'i ngo bor gnas pas shes pa zab pa dang*/ don dam pa'i byang chub ni spyod pas mchog dman du mi 'gyur yang*/ kun rdzob yid kyi kun tu slong ba dang 'brel ba'i lus ngag gi spyod pa'i khyad par mchog dman gyis blo bur gyi dri ma yod pa ltar snang ba dang*/ bsal ba ltar snang bas spyod pa zab pa dang*/ btags pa kun rdzob pa'i chos can dang chos nyid gnyis su med pa bzhin/ rdzas su yod pa don dam pa'i chos can chos nyid gnyis su med pa ste/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis bden gnyis so so'i chos can dang chos nyid gnyis su med pas zab pa dang*/

kun rdzob kyi ngor sangs rgyas gdod sangs rgyas dgos pa ltar 'tshang rgya ba'i thabs kyi rgyu rkyen 'tshol zhing*/ don dam par gdod ma nas sangs rgyas zin pa nyid sangs rgyas su grub par ston pa'i thabs mkhas pa la nye bar sbyor ba zab pa nyid de/ rtogs par dka' ba gting mi dpogs pa ste brgyad do//gsum pa sgom rim khyad par can la gsum/ srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba/ zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba/ thabs mkhas pa'i sbyor ba bcu sgom pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ dngos kyi don dang*/ klan ka spang ba'o/ /dang po ni/ chos rnams rmi lam 'dra ba'i phyir//srid dang zhi bar mi rtog pa//zhes gsungs te/ chos rnams rang bzhin med de/ rmi lam dang 'dra ba'i phyir/ srid pa dang zhi ba'i chos rang mtshan par mi rtog cing mi dmigs/ de mi dmigs pas las dang rgyu 'bras kyi ltos pa chad nas zhi ba la gnas pa yin no//gnyis pa klan ka spang ba ni/ las med la sogs klan ka yi//lan ni ji skad bshad par zad// 70 ces gsungs te/ de ltar na las gsog pa med par thal ba la sogs kyi klan ka'i lan ni/ mdo nas ji skad du bshad pa de kho na ltar zad kyi/ 'dir tshig zin du ma smos so//gnyis pa zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba ni/ sems can 'jig rten de bzhin du//snod kyi 'jig rten ma dag pa//de la dag par sgrub pa yi//sangs rgyas zhing ni dag pa nyid// 71 ces gsungs te/ 'khrul pa'i sems can ma dag pa'i 'jig rten rim gyis sbyang bar byas pa'i sgo nas don dam pa'i sems can mngon par gsal bar sgrub cing*/ de bzhin du 'khrul ngor shar ba'i snod kyi 'jig rten ma dag pa de sbyang bar byas la/ de la dag pa 'jig rten gyi khams sngar yod gsal bar sgrub pa'i sbyor bas sangs rgyas go chod po'i zhing ni 'khrul snang gis rnam par dag pa nyid yin la/ de lta bu'i rnam dag nyid la nor bu baiḍūr+ya sogs kyi sa gzhi lta bu zhes sogs 'khrul ngo'i dngos po ya mtshan che ba la dper mtshon pa yin gyi/

gzhan du dag pa 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bkod pa ma dag pa sems can gyi blo la 'char du mi rung ba yin no//gsum pa thabs mkhas kyi sbyor ba bcu sgom pa ni/ yul dang sbyor ba can 'di ni//dgra rnams las ni 'das pa dang*//mi gnas ji bzhin shugs dang ni//thun mong ma yin mtshan nyid dang*// 72 ma chags pa dang mi dmigs dang*//mtshan ma smon lam zad pa dang*//de yi rtags dang tshad med pa//thabs la mkhas pa rnam pa bcu// 73 zhes gsungs te/ chos kyi dbyings kyi yul zab mo mkhyen pa gsum dang*/ de mngon du byed pa'i thabs mkhas kyi sbyor ba khyad par can 'di la ni skyes bu dpa' bos dgra rnams bcom nas gnyen bshes dang bcas pa 'brog dgon par thar pa'i dpes/ snying rje dang shes rab kyis rim bzhin srid zhi'i dgra rnams las ni 'das pa'i thabs mkhas dang*/ bya bar snang la rgyu ba'i dpes stong nyid la spyod kyang stong nyid la mi gnas shing 'dris par byed pa'i thabs mkhas dang*/ 'phong la shin tu goms pa ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin mda' 'phen pa'i dpes ji srid dge ba rnams rdzogs byang du ma smin pa de srid yang dag mtha' mngon du mi byed cing*/ smin pa na mngon du byed pa'i thabs mkhas pa ji lta ba bzhin du goms pa'i shugs kyis yang dag mtha' mngon du byed pa la/ tshegs med pa'i thabs la mkhas pa dang ni/ shes rab kyis yang dag pa'i mtha' la slob kyang bar ma dor zhi bar mi ltung ba'i rgyu snying rjes sems can mi gtong ba ni nyan rang dang thun mong ma yin pa'i mtshan nyid kyi thabs la mkhas pa dang*/ gang zag gi bdag dang phyin ci log bzhi la ma chags pa'i thabs la mkhas pa dang*/ bdag gnyis mi dmigs pa'am stong pa'i thabs mkhas dang*/ spros pa'i mtshan ma zad pa'i thabs la mkhas pa dang*/ khams gsum par smon pa'i smon lam zad pa'i thabs mkhas dang*/ thabs mkhas dang ldan pa'i sems dpa' de sangs rgyas kyis bla med byang chub tu lung bstan pa'i rtags stong nyid la 'dris par byed pa ston pa'i thabs mkhas dang*/

rtags thob pa dang ma thob pa la sogs pa'i shes bya tshad med pa shes pa'i thabs la mkhas pa ste de ltar thabs la mkhas pa rnam pa bcu'o//gnyis pa skabs kyi grangs brjod pas mjug bsdu ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa las/ skabs bzhi pa'o// //zhes gsungs te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan ces bya ba las/ skabs bzhi pa'i 'grel bshad rdzogs so// //skabs lnga pa/ rtse mo'i sbyor ba/ gnyis pa dbang sgyur thob pa rtse mo'i sbyor ba la gnyis/ mtshon byed kyi chos rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ skabs kyi grangs brjod pas mjug bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ gnyen po'i rtse mo dang*/ spang bya log sgrub bo/ /dang po la bzhi/ sbyor lam/ mthong lam/ sgom lam rtse mo/ bar chad med pa'i rtse mo'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ drod kyi rtse mo rtags kyis mtshon pa dang*/ rtse mo'i rtse mo rnam par 'phel ba dang*/ bzod pa'i rtse mo brtan pa dang*/ chos mchog gi sems kun tu gnas pa'o/ /dang po ni/rmi lam na yang chos rnams kun//rmi lam lta bur lta la sogs//rtse mor phyin pa'i sbyor ba'i rtags//rnam pa bcu gnyis dag tu bzhed// 1 ces gsungs te/ drod kyi rtse sbyor mnyam bzhag tu thob pa rjes thob tu sad pa na/ chos rnams rmi lam 'dra bar blta bar ma zad/ rmi lam na yang chos rnams kun rmi lam lta bur blta ba dang*/ la sogs pas nyan thos la sogs pa'i sa la dga' ba'i sems mi bskyed pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs pa mthong ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam par 'phrul pa dmigs pa dang*/ chos ston pa'i sems skye ba dang*/ dmyal ba la sogs pa'i sems can mthong ba sngon du 'gro bas rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing du ngan song spong ba rjes su dran pa dang*/ grong khyer la sogs pa tshig pa rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i bden pa'i byin gyis brlabs grub pa dang*/

gnod sbyin la sogs pa mi ma yin pa med par byed pa'i bden pa'i tshig grub pa dang*/ rang nyid mngon par shes pas pha rol du non pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa dang*/ rnam pa thams cad du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la slob pa dang*/ chos thams cad la mngon par zhen pa med pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi byang chub la nye bar gyur pa ste rtse mor phyin pa'i sbyor ba thob pa'i rtags ni rnam pa bcu gnyis dag tu bcom ldan 'das bzhed do//gnyis pa rtse mo'i rnam par 'phel ba ni/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi skye bo snyed//sangs rgyas mchod pa'i dge la sogs//rnam mang du ni dper mdzad nas//rnam 'phel bcu drug bdag nyid do// 2 zhes gsungs te/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi skye bo ji snyed sangs rgyas su gyur pa la 'ga' zhig gis nam 'tsho'i bar du mchod pa'i dge ba dang*/ la sogs pas stong gsum gyi skye bo ji snyed sangs rgyas su gyur pa la nam 'tsho'i bar du mchod pa'i dge ba ste gnyis dang*/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can ji snyed pa mir gyur la/ de dag la la zhig gis dge ba bcu dang bsam gtan gzugs med mngon shes lnga ste 'jig rten pa'i phun tshogs dang*/ rgyun zhugs dang*/ phyir 'ong ba dang*/ phyir mi 'ong ba dang*/ dgra bcom pa dang*/ rang byang chub dang*/ bla med byang chub la bkod de/ de dag gi dge ba yang rang rang gi skabs su sangs rgyas su bsngos pa'i dge ba bdun dang*/ stong gsum gyi sems can ji snyed pa mir gyur la/ de dag la la zhig gis 'jig rten pa'i phun tshogs dang*/ rgyun zhugs dang*/ phyir 'ong dang*/ phyir mi 'ong dang*/ dgra bcom pa dang*/ rang byang chub dang*/ bla na med pa'i byang chub la bkod cing*/ de lta bu'i dge ba yang rang rang gi skabs su sangs rgyas su bsngos pa dang bcas pa'i bsod nams bdun no/ /de ltar bdun tshan gnyis kyi steng du snga ma gnyis te/ de ltar na dge ba bcu drug gi rnam pa mang du bstan pa ni dper mdzad nas/

rtse sbyor la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chos thams cad rmi lam lta bur yid la byed pa dang ma bral bas sher phyin la spyod cing gzhan la ston pa ni dge ba snga ma las dge ba'i rnam pa ches mang du 'phel ba bcu drug gi bdag nyid do//gsum pa bzod pa'i rtse mo brtan pa ni/ kun mkhyen nyid gsum chos rnams kyi//yongs su rdzogs pa bla med pa//sems can don yongs mi gtong ba//brtan pa zhes ni mngon par brjod// 3 ces gsungs te/ kun mkhyen nyid gsum gyi chos sems bskyed pa la sogs pa'i yon tan rnams kyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sar yongs su rdzogs pa bla na med pa'i rtogs pa bstan pa dang*/ sems can gyi don glo bur gyi dri ma sel ba'i thabs yongs su mi gtong bar gzhan gyi don 'ba' zhig la gnas par brtan pa zhes pa ni mngon par brjod do//'dir mkhyen gsum gyis mtshon pa'i dge ba tsam yin gyi/ go don mngon rtogs brgyad yongs rdzogs kyi dge ba byang chub tu bsngo bar bstan pa yin no//bzhi pa chos mchog gi rtse mo sems kun tu gnas pa ni/ gling bzhi pa dang stong dag dang*//stong gnyis gsum dag dper mdzad nas//bsod nams mang po nyid kyis ni//ting 'dzin yongs su bsgrags pa yin// 4 zhes gsungs te/ gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten stong nas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten stong gi bar ni stong dang po dag dang*/ de stong la stong gnyis bar ma dang*/ bar ma stong la stong gsum gyi stong chen po dag kyang rdul phra rab nas tshad gzung bar nus pa'i dper mdzad nas/ chos mchog gi skabs kyi rtse sbyor dge rtsa la rjes su yi rang ba sogs bsod nams mang po tshad bzung bar mi nus pa nyid kyis ni skabs 'di'i ting nge 'dzin bsod nams tshad med par 'phel bar yongs su bsgrags pa yin no//gnyis pa mthong lam rtse mo la drug ste/ spang bya rnam par rtog pa dang*/ skye ba'i rgyu grogs dang*/

'bras bu byang chub dang*/ rtse mo'i byed pa dang*/ de'i ngo bo dang*/ sgom pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ gzung rtog mdor bstan/ 'dzin rtog mdor bstan/ gzung 'dzin gyi dbye ba'i nges pa rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'jug pa dang ni ldog pa la//gzung ba'i rnam rtog so sor de//dgu yi bdag nyid ji bzhin yul//min pa'i bdag nyid dag shes bya// 5 zhes gsungs te/ yul sgrub par mthong ba'i sgo nas 'jug pa'i rnam par rtog pa dang ni/ yul dgag par 'du shes pa'i sgo nas ldog pa'i rnam rtog la gzung ba'i rnam par rtog pa gnyis po so so ba de la dbye na/ rnam pa dgu dgu'i bdag nyid du phye ba de ji lta ba bzhin gyi yul ni rang gi ngo bor yod pa min pa'i bdag nyid dag tu shes par bya'o//gnyis pa 'dzin rtog mdor bstan pa ni/ so so'i skye bo 'phags dbye bas//sems can rdzas dang btags yod par//rnam rtog 'dzin pa dag tu 'dod//de dag so sor dgu bdag nyid// 6 gal te gzung don de bzhin med//de dag gang gis 'dzin par 'dod//de ltar de dag 'dzin pa yi//ngo bos stong pa'i mtshan nyid do// 7 zhes gsungs te/ rten so so'i skye bo dang*/ 'phags pa'i dbye bas go rim bzhin du sems can rdzas su yod par rtog pa so skye'i 'dzin rtog dang*/ skyes bu btags pa tsam du yod pa rnam par rtog pa 'phags pa'i 'dzin pa'i rtog pa dag tu 'dod do//des na 'dzin rtog de dag kyang yul gyi sgo nas so sor dgu dgu'i bdag nyid du 'chad par 'gyur la/ de ltar 'chad kyang*/ 'o na gal te gzung don gyi don dngos po dang rtog yul gyi dngos po med na rdzas dang btags pa'i ngo bo'ang de bzhin du med pas rdzas dang btags pa de dag gang gis 'dzin par 'dod de/ 'dod par mi rigs so/ /gzung don med pa de ltar de dag 'dzin pa'i ngo bos dben pa'i phyir/ stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid de las gzhan ma yin pa nyid do//'dir rkang pa snga mas gang zag gang la rtog pa 'di gnyis gang ldan pa'i tshul bstan/

gang la rtog pa'i yul ni sems can zhes pa des bstan la/ de yang 'dir gang zag la rdzas rtog gi yul yin pa dngos su bstan la/ gang zag tu 'dogs pa'i gzhi chos la rdzas rtog gi yul yin pa shugs la bstan to//gsum pa gzung 'dzin gyi dbye ba'i nges pa rgyas par bshad pa la bzhi ste/ 'jug pa'i gzung rtog dgu /ldog pa'i gzung rtog dgu /gang zag rdzas 'dzin gyi rtog pa dgu /skyes bu btags 'dzin gyi rtog pa dgu'o/ /dang po ni/ ngo bo nyid dang rigs dang ni//lam ni yang dag 'grub pa dang*//shes pa'i dmigs pa ma 'khrul dang*//mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po dang*// 8 rang gis rtogs dang byed pa dang*//de yi las bya'i 'bras bu la//'jug pa'i phyogs kyi rten can gyi//rnam rtog de ni rnam dgur 'dod// 9 ces gsungs te/ gnas lugs btags pas dben pa'i ngo bo nyid dang*/ theg chen gyi rigs zag med kyi shes pa dang ni/ zag med kyi shes pa'i rigs khams sbyangs pas lam ni yang dag 'grub pa dang*/ lam shes pa'i dmigs pa ma 'khrul ba dang*/ mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po'i 'dor len shes pa dang*/ mkhyen gsum sems dpa' rang gis rtogs pa dang*/ rtogs nas rang don yid byed kyi thag sring bar byed pa dang*/ lam shes de'i byed las sems can gyi don dang*/ bya ba'i 'bras bu tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa la 'jug pa'i phyogs kyi sems dpa' rnam byang gi rten can gyis rnam rtog de ni rnam pa dgur 'dod do//gnyis pa ldog pa gzung rtog dgu 'chad pa ni/ srid dang zhi bar ltung ba'i phyir//rtogs pa dman pa nyid dang ni//yongs su 'dzin pa med pa dang*//lam gyi rnam pa ma tshang dang*// 10 gzhan gyi rkyen gyis 'gro ba dang*//ched du bya ba log pa dang*//nyi tshe ba dang sna tshogs nyid//gnas dang 'jug la rmongs pa dang*// 11 rjes la 'gro zhes bya ba la//rnam rtog dgu yi bdag nyid 'di//ldog pa'i phyogs kyi rten can te//nyan thos la sogs yid las 'byung*//

12 zhes gsungs te/ nyan thos kyi lam thabs shes dang bral zhing srid dang zhi ba gang rung gi mthar ltung ba'i phyir rtogs pa dman pa nyid dang ni/ theg pa chen po'i sar bkri ba'i yongs su 'dzin pa med pas yongs su 'dzin pa dman pa dang*/ sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i lam gyi cha'i rnam pa ma tshang bas lam dman pa nyid dang*/ nyan thos kyi 'bras bu thob pa de rnam mkhyen du 'gro ba na/ theg pa gzhan sher phyin gyi rkyen gyis bgrod dgos pas 'gro ba dbang po dman pa dang*/ ched du gnyer bar bya ba rnam mkhyen las log pas thams cad mkhyen pa'i thabs la dman pa dang*/ gang zag gi bdag tsam spangs pas spangs pa dman pa nyi tshe ba dang*/ mtshan mar 'dzin pa sna tshogs la dmigs pa nyid kyis ye shes dman pa dang*/ rnam mkhyen du gnas pa dang gnas pa la 'jug pa'i gzhan don la rmongs pas gzhan don dman pa dang*/ nyan thos kyi 'bras bu thob kyang slar sbyin sogs lnga dang sher phyin gyi rjes su 'brangs nas sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'gro ba zhes bya ba la/ rnam par rtog pa dgu yi bdag nyid 'di ni/ ldog pa'i phyogs kyi rten can te/ nyan thos dang la sogs pas rang rgyal gyi sa las yid 'byung bar byed do//gsum pa gang zag rdzas 'dzin gyi rtog pa dgu 'chad pa ni/ 'dzin pa dang ni 'dor ba dang*//yid la byed dang khams rnams ni//gsum po dag dang nyer 'brel dang*//gnas dang mngon par zhen pa dang*// 13 chos kyi dngos po btags pa dang*//chags pa dang ni gnyen po dang*//ji ltar 'dod bzhin 'gro nyams la//'dzin pa dang por shes par bya// 14 zhes gsungs te/ gzugs sogs su grub pa'i chos la yon tan du 'dzin pa dang ni/ skyon du rtog nas 'dor ba dang*/ blang dor gyi rgyu yid la byed pa dang*/ yid la byed pa'i chos dang sems can gyi khams rnams ni khams gsum po dag dang nye bar 'brel ba dang*/ bden pa'i rdzas la gnas pa dang*/ der rdzas dngos su mngon par zhen pa dang*/

zhen bya'i chos kyi dngos po med bzhin du rdzas su yongs su btags pa dang*/ 'khor gsum du zhen nas chags pa dang ni/ de'i gnyen po yul bden pa'i rdzas su 'dzin pa dang*/ de ltar rdzas su 'dzin pa'i mthus sangs rgyas kyi sar ji ltar 'dod bzhin du 'gro ba las nyams pa la mngon par zhen nas 'dzin pa dang por shes par bya'o//bzhi pa btags 'dzin rtog pa dgu 'chad pa ni/ ched bzhin nges par mi 'byung dang*//lam la lam min nges 'dzin dang*//'gag dang bcas pa'i skye ba dang*//dngos po ldan dang mi ldan dang*// 15 gnas dang rigs ni 'jig pa dang*//don du gnyer dang rgyu med dang*//phyir rgol ba ni dmigs pa la//'dzin pa'i rnam rtog gzhan yin no// 16 zhes gsungs te/ nyan thos kyis ched du bya ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sar 'gro ba bzhin du nges par mi 'byung bas theg dman gyi byang chub la dmigs pa dang*/ theg chen gyi lam la lam mchog min par nges par 'dzin pa dang*/ rgyu 'gag pa dang bcas pa'i 'bras bu skye ba la dmigs pa dang*/ btags pa'i dngos po dang ldan la/ rdzas kyi dngos po dang mi ldan par rtog pa dang*/ gzugs sogs la snang btags su gnas pa dang*/ nyan rang gi rigs ni rang bzhin gyis 'jig par byed pa dang*/ lam sgrub pa don du gnyer ba dang*/ lam shes kyi rgyu med pa dang*/ bdud sogs phyir rgol ba ni dngos por dmigs pa la sogs te dgu po 'di ni 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog snga ma las dgu tshan gzhan yin no//gnyis pa skye ba'i rgyu grogs ni/ byang chub la gzhan ston pa dang*//de yi rgyu ni yongs gtad dang*//de thob bar chad med pa'i rgyu//bsod nams mang po'i mtshan nyid do// 17 zhes gsungs te/ sher phyin la spyod pa'i byang sems kyis bla med byang chub thob par nges pa'i phyir sngon byung ston pa'i rnam thar las brtsams te byang chub dam pa la 'jug par byed pa'i gdul bya gzhan sher phyin la spyod pa'i dge slong brgya drug cu bskal pa skar ma lta bu la bla med byang chub tu 'tshang rgya ste/

me tog sil ma zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa sha stag 'jig rten du 'byung bar lung ston pa dang*/ des na byang chub 'dod pas sher phyin la slob dgos shing*/ slob pa de'ang sher phyin gyi tshig don 'khrul med thos pa la rag pas byang chub de thob par byed pa'i rgyu sher phyin gyi tshig don ni chud ma zos par bzung zhing khong du chub par byas nas gzhan la ston cing rgya cher spel zhig ces kun dga' bo la yongs su gtad pa dang*/ de ltar gtad pa'i tshig don 'khrul med nyams su blangs pa'i byang sems chos mchog la gnas pa'i sher phyin sgom pa des byang chub de thob pa la bar chad med par mthun pa'i rgyu'i rkyen yin pas/ mthong lam gyi mngon rtogs 'dren pa'i phyir de'i rgyud la bsod nams tshad med pa mang po 'byung ba'i mtshan nyid can nyid do//sngon byung las brtsams nas rjes 'jug 'khor gyi nyams len kyang sher phyin la spyod na nges par byang chub par lung bstan cing*/ byang chub de'i rgyu sher phyin nyid kyi tshig don gzhan gyi rgyud la gtod pa dang*/ de ltar gtad de bsgoms pas skabs 'dir bstan gyi mthong ba'i lam byang chub kyi cha shas de mngon du byed pa la sbyor ba'i phyir/ 'bras bu bsod nams mang du 'phel ba'i rang bzhin can yin no//gsum pa 'bras bu byang chub la gsum/ byang chub chen po'i ngo bo bshad/ de dngos stobs kyi rigs pas dgag khas blangs nang 'gal gyis dgag pa'o//dang po ni/ dri ma zad dang mi skye ba'i//ye shes byang chub ces brjod de//zad med skye med phyir de dag/go rim bzhin du shes par bya// 18 zhes gsungs te/ gdod ma nyid nas dri ma zad pa dang*/ gzod ma nas 'dus byas par mi skye ba'i phyir phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes ni byang chub de'i ngo bo yin ces brjod cing bstan te/ gang gi phyir dri ma sngar yod glo bur du zad pa med pa'i phyir dang*/

skye ba sngar yod glo bur du gegs byas nas skye med du song ba med pa'i phyir*/ de dag go rim bzhin du dri ma zad pa'i ye shes dang ma skye ba'i ye shes zhes shes par bya'o//gnyis pa dngos stobs kyi rigs pas 'gag pa ni/ 'gog pa med pa'i rang bzhin la//mthong zhes bya ba'i lam gyis ni//rnam par rtog rigs ci zhig zad//skye med rnam pa ci zhig 'thob// 19 ces gsungs te/ glo bur gyi dri ma gdod ma nas yod ma myong ba'i 'dus ma byas kyi byang chub chen po la slar glo bur gyi dri ma zhig 'gog mi dgos pa'i phyir/ 'gog pa med pa'i rang bzhin rnam dag 'di la mthong zhes bya ba'i lam gyi nus pas ni sngar yod kyi rnam par rtog pa'i rigs ci zhig zad par byas te ma byas la/ sngar med kyi skye med rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi rnam pa ci zhig 'thob ste thob byar med do//gsum pa khas blangs nang 'gal gyis dgag pa ni/ gzhan gyi chos rnams kyang yod la//shes bya la yang ston pa yi//sgrib pa zad par brjod pa gang*//de la kho bos mtshar du rtsis// 20 zhes gsungs te/ gzhan gyi chos glo bur gyi dri ma rnams kyang gdod ma nas byang chub kyi rang bzhin ltar spang du mi rung bar yod la/ de ltar na shes bya la yang blang dor gyi gnas ston pa'i bcom ldan 'das 'dis sgrib pa gdod nas yod pa rnams lam gyis glo bur du zad par byas pa yin ces brjod pa gang yin pa rigs pa dang 'gal ba de la kho bo mtshar du brtsis nas dngos po rang bzhin yod pa ni gang med par bsgyur mi nus la/ gang dngos po'i rang bzhin med pa ni gang gis kyang yod par bsgyur mi nus pa'i phyir ro//bzhi pa mthong lam rtse mo'i byed pa ni/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med//bzhag par bya ba cung zad med//yang dag nyid la yang dag lta//yang dag mthong na rnam par grol// 21 zhes gsungs te/ stong nyid spros pa thams cad bral ba'i gnas lugs rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba 'di la don dam 'khrul med kyi cha bsal bya ci yang med la/

kun rdzob 'khrul pa'i cha bzhag par bya ba cung zad kyang med pas/ yang dag pa'i de bzhin nyid kyi gnas tshul la yul gyi gnas tshul dang mthun par chos bdag med par rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis yang dag par bltas pa na/ bdag rang ngo nyid kyis grub pa sogs rang bzhin gyis dben par yang dag par mthong ba'am/ rtogs pa'am khong du chud pas chos kyi bdag 'dzin las rnam par grol bar byed do//lnga pa mthong lam rtse mo'i ngo bo ni/ sbyin pa la sogs re rer ni//de dag phan tshun bsdus pa gang*//skad cig gcig pa'i bzod pa yis//bsdus pa de 'dir mthong ba'i lam// 22 zhes gsungs te/ sbyin pa la sogs pa phyin drug re rer ni phar phyin rang rang las gzhan pa lnga po de dag phan tshun du bsdus pa'i ye shes gang yin pa mthong lam gyi ye shes skad cig ma gcig pa sdug bsngal la chos shes pa'i bzod pa yis bsdus pa'i bar chad med lam de 'dir mthong ba'i lam gyi rtse mor bstan to//drug pa de sgom pa ni/ de nas seng ge rnam bsgyings pa'i//ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs nas//rten cing 'brel 'byung lugs mthun dang*//lugs mi mthun la rtog par byed//23 ces gsungs te/ mthong lam rtse mo thob pa'i rjes de nas mthar gnas dgu'i bdag nyid can gyi ngo bo nyid kyi seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de las ldang ba na 'khor ba'i rten cing 'brel 'byung lugs mthun dang*/ myang 'das kyi rten cing 'brel 'byung lugs mi mthun la rtog par byed pa yin no//gsum pa sgom lam rtse mo la drug ste/ gnyen po sgom pa'i lam gyi rang bzhin gang yin pa dang*/ spang bya dngos po tsam la brten pa'i gzung rtog dgu /spang bya rnam byang tsam la brten pa'i gzung rtog dgu /spang bya gang zag tsam la brten pa'i 'dzin rtog dgu /spang bya der 'dogs pa'i rgyu tsam la brten pa'i 'dzin rtog dgu

/de ltar spangs pas phye ba'i yon tan bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'gog dang bcas pa'i snyoms 'jug dgur//rnam pa gnyis su song 'ongs nas//'dod par gtogs pa'i rnam par shes//mnyam bzhag min pas mtshams bzung ste// 24 thod rgal du ni snyoms 'jug pa//gcig dang gnyis gsum bzhi dang lnga//drug dang bdun dang brgyad rgal nas//'gog pa'i bar du mi 'drar 'gro/ 25zhes gsungs te/ yul bsam gtan brgyad dang gzugs med brgyad 'gog pa dang bcas pa'i mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug dgur rnam pa gnyis su yar song ba dang phyir 'ongs pa nas 'jug pa'i tshul de ni 'di skabs kyi seng ge rnam bsgyings yin la/ thod rgal chung ngu ni/ snyoms par 'jug tshul seng bsgyings dang 'dra ba la dgongs nas rtsa bar ma bstan kyang don gyis go bar 'gyur ba la dgongs so/ /thod rgal 'bring ni/ rtsa bar ma btus shing 'grel par kha bskangs nas bshad par mdzad pa yin no/ /thod rgal chen po ni/ 'dod par gtogs pa'i rnam par shes pa mnyam gzhag min pas mtshams bzung ste thod rgal du ni snyoms par 'jug pa'i tshul yod de/ bsam gtan dang po dang*/ gnyis pa gsum pa bzhi pa dang*/ gzugs med skye mched dang po ste lnga pa dang*/ gnyis pa ste drug pa dang*/ gsum pa ste bdun pa dang*/ bzhi pa ste brgyad pa rnams la rim bzhin snyoms par 'jug rim nas brgal nas mthar 'gog pa'i bar du 'dod sems kyis spel nas mi 'dra bar 'gro ba yin no//gnyis pa spang bya dngos po tsam la brten pa'i gzung rtog dgu ni/ mdor bsdus rgyas dang sangs rgyas kyis//btang bas yongs su ma bzung dang*//dus gsum yon tan med pa dang*//legs pa'i lam ni rnam gsum la// 26 gzung ba'i rnam rtog 'di gcig ste//sbyor ba'i rnam pa'i spyod yul can//zhes gsungs te/ de'ang gnas lugs rgyal ba'i yum gnyis med kyi ye shes kyi ngo bor gnas la de tsam du mdor bsdus te bshad pa dang*/

yang gnas tshul du zhugs ma zhugs kyi chos thams cad kyi rang spyi'i mtshan nyid rgyas par bstan pa dang*/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis mgon du byas pa ste/ brda rnying las btang bas yum la mi slob pa'i sems can dag yongs su ma bzung ba dang zhes smos la/ mgon du yongs su ma bzung ba de'ang mthar thug gi skyabs la des skyabs ma zhus pas de yongs su 'dzin ma nus pa yin te/ dkon mchog la dad nas des dkon mchog gis gang gsungs la blang dor ma byas pa'i phyir/ de ma byas na yongs su bzung bar rloms yang yongs su bzung du ma btub pa yin no/ /de'i shugs kyis dkon mchog la dad pas rtog na mgon du yang dag par 'dzin par shes par bya'o/ /tshig rkang dang po gnyis kyis rtog pa gsum po 'di ni shes bya'i lam gyi dbang du byas pa'o/ /lam de'i yon tan gyi dbang du byas pa ni/ yum 'di la dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas byung ba'i yon tan med pa las bzlog ste/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i yon tan yod par shes pa gsum dang*/ lam gyi ngo bo'i dbang du byas na nges par legs pa'i lam ni mos pas spyod pa dang*/ ma dag sa dang*/ dag pa'i sa ste rnam pa gsum du byas te/ de ltar rtog pa'i rtog pa dgu yod pa la yon tan du mthong ba'i gzung ba'i rnam par rtog pa gnyis yod pa las/ gzung ba'i rnam rtog 'di ni dang po gcig pu de yin te/ yul sbyor ba'i rnam pa de'i spyod yul du byas pa'i yul can yin no//gsum pa spang bya rnam byang la brten pa'i gzung rtog dgu ni/ gnyis pa sems dang sems byung rnams//'jug pa'i yul can yin bzhed de// 27 sems mi skye dang byang chub kyi//snying po yid la mi byed dang*//theg pa dman pa yid byed dang*//rdzogs pa'i byang chub yid mi byed// 28 sgom dang sgom pa med pa dang*//de dag las ni bzlog nyid dang*//ji bzhin don min rnam rtog pa//sgom pa'i lam la shes par bya//

29 zhes gsungs te/ gzung rtog gnyis pa 'di ni sems dang sems byung rnams yul la 'phro zhing 'jug pa'i yul can gyi gzung rtog dgu yin par bzhed de/ de dgu yang*/ byang chub kyi sems mi skye ba dang*/ bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi snying po yid la mi byed pa'i sems sems byung rgyud la 'jug pa dang*/ theg pa dman pa yid byed kyi sems dang*/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub yid la mi byed pa'i sems dang*/ sher phyin bsgoms pas rnam mkhyen thob bam snyam pa'i sems rgyu ba dang*/ sgom pa med pas rnam mkhyen thob bam snyam pa dang*/ de dag las ni bzlog pa bsgoms kyang bsgoms la ma bsgoms kyang ma bsgoms pas thob bam snyam pa'i sems kyi rgyu ba nyid dang*/ ji lta ba bzhin gyi de kho na nyid kyi don min par 'jug pa'i sems kyi rnam par rtog pa dgu ni/ sgom pa'i lam la spang bya de lta bu yod pa shes par bya'o//bzhi pa gang zag tsam la brten pa'i rtog pa dgu ni/ sems can btags pa'i spyod yul dang*//chos btags pa dang stong min nyid//chags dang rab 'byed bdag nyid dang*//dngos por byed dang theg gsum dang*// 30yon ni dag pa ma yin dang*//spyod pa rnam par 'khrugs pa la//'dzin par byed pa dang por de//shes par bya ba bsgrags pa yin// 31zhes gsungs te/ gang 'du shes dang ldan pa la sems can du btags te dngos por 'dzin pa'i spyod yul can dang*/ chos thams cad btags pa ltar dngos yod du zhen pa dang*/ don dam par stong pa nyid min par zhen pa nyid de/ shes bya yul gyi dbang du byas pa dang*/ dmigs pa'i yul la chags pa dang*/ chos kyi mtshan nyid rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i bdag nyid kyi blo ste/ snga ma ni nyan thos kyis yul la 'jug tshul dang*/ phyi ma ni byang sems kyis yul la 'jug tshul gyi dbang du byas pa'o//yid kyis chos thams cad la dngos po'i 'du byed pa las byung ba'i dngos por zhen pa dang*/

theg pa gsum so sor bden par zhen pa ste/ de'i ched kyis blo'i mos pa'i dbang du byas pa dang*/ sher phyin la gzhol ba ma yin pas yon gyi gnas dag pa ma yin pa dang*/ sbyin sogs thabs cha'i spyod pa rnam par 'khrugs pa ste/ dang po ni/ lta ba las nyams pa dang*/ phyi ma ni/ spyod pa las nyams pa'i rtog pa dgu la 'dzin par byed pa'i rtog pa dang por smras ma thag pa de dag rnams shes par bya ba'i phyir bsgrags pa yin no//lnga pa spang bya der 'dogs pa'i rgyu tsam la brten pa'i 'dzin rtog dgu 'chad pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sems can btags dang de'i rgyu yi//yul can de yis rnam 'joms pas//sgom pa'i lam dang 'brel ba yi//mi mthun phyogs gzhan rnam pa dgu/ 32 zhes gsungs te/ sems can du btags pa dang*/ der btags pa'i de'i rgyu'i yul can du gyur pa'i 'dzin rtog ni gnyen po sgom lam de yis rnam par 'joms pas spang bya 'dzin rtog dang*/ gnyen po sgom pa'i lam dag lhan cig mi gnas pa'i 'gal bar gnas pa dang*/ 'gal dmigs kyi sbyor ba de dag gi rtags ldog khyab kyi steng du brtsi na/ bdag gcig 'brel ba'i sgo nas 'jog la/ sgom lam de'i mi mthun phyogs 'dzin rtog dang po las gzhan rnam pa dgu ston to//gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa ni/ bdag nyid ji bzhin kun mkhyen ni//gsum gyi sgrib pa rnam gsum dang*//zhi lam de bzhin nyid sogs dang*//mtshungs par ldan dang mi ldan dang*// 33mi mnyam sdug bsngal la sogs dang*//nyon mongs rnams kyi rang bzhin dang*//gnyis su med la kun rmongs la//rnam par rtog pa tha mar bzhed// 34ces gsungs te/ ngo bo nyid kyi bdag nyid ji lta ba bzhin kun tu mkhyen pa ni gsum gyi ngo bo rnam par dag pa la sgrib byed kyi sgrib pa rnam pa gsum dang*/ theg pa gsum gyi zhi ba'i lam dang*/ de bzhin nyid dang*/

la sogs pas yang dag pa'i mtha' dang*/ sher phyin ngo bo mtshungs par ldan dang mi ldan du the tshom za ba dang*/ de nyid yod pa las gzhan med pa'i phyir mi mnyam pa dang*/ sdug bsngal dang la sogs pas bden pa bzhi dang*/ nyon mongs pa rnams kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang*/ gnyis su med pa'i ngo bo la de dang der thams cad la bden par 'dzin pa'i kun nas rmongs pa la 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa dgu tshan tha mar bzhed do//drug pa de ltar spangs pas phye ba'i yon tan bshad pa ni/ yams nad 'di rnams zad nas ni//yun ring lon nas dbugs phyin ltar//rnam pa kun tu 'gro ba yi//bde sgrub yon tan phun tshogs kun// 35 rgya mtsho che la chu bo bzhin//'bras bu mchog gis spa ba yi//sems dpa' chen po de la ni//rnam pa kun tu brten par byed// 36 ces gsungs te/ sems can thams cad la 'byung ba'i gzung 'dzin gyi yams nad 'di rnams sman chen po dang 'dra ba'i lam shes kyis zad par byas nas ni/ sngon thog ma med pa nas kun rtog gis dub pa'i sdug bsngal gyi nad yun ring zhig lon nas sos te bde bar dbugs phyin pa ltar gyur pa'i sems dpa' rnam pa kun tu 'gro ba'i bde ba mtha' dag sgrub par byed pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa kun sangs rgyas phal po che las 'byung ba ltar/ rgya mtsho chen po la 'dzam bu'i gling nas chu klung stong phrag phyed dang gsum/ nub nas stong phrag lnga/ byang nas stong phrag bcu/ shar nas stong phrag phyed dang brgyad 'bab bo/ /de rnams las klu'i rgyal po 'od zer bcu pa'i sprin las byung ba'i chu mang ngo*/ /de la sogs pa klu'i rgyal po khrag khrig brgyad cu'i sprin las byung ba'i chu'o/ /de bas klu'i rgyal po gangs can mtsho'i bu 'dzam bu'i rgyal mtshan gyi sprin gyi chu mang ngo*/ /de dag thams cad pas gangs can mtsho'i gnas nas 'bab pa'i chu klung ¿baiḍūr+ya ¿lta bu zhes bya ba'i chu mang ngo*/

/de dag thams cad kyis kyang rgya mtsho chen po'i bres las 'da' bar mi nus par gsungs te/ chu bo chen po tshad med pa brten pa de bzhin du 'bras bu don gnyis mthar phyin pa'i rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mchog gi go 'phang mngon du byed ka ma'i spa ba ste gzi brjid dang*/ rngam par ldan pa'i sems dpa' chen po de la ni yon tan gyis rnam pa kun tu tshur brten par byed pa yin te/ de ni de lta bu'i byang sems 'tshang rgya ka ma yin pa'i phyir ro//bzhi pa bar chad med pa'i rtse mo la gnyis/ dpe dang rang ldog ngos gzung ba dang*/ dmigs pa dang bdag po rnam pa rnams bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ stong gsum skye bo nyan thos dang*//bse ru'i rtogs pa phun tshogs dang*//byang chub sems dpa'i skyon med la//bkod pa'i dge ba dper mdzad nas//37 bsod nams mang po nyid kyis ni//sangs rgyas nyid kyi bar med de//bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin//de ni rnam pa kun mkhyen nyid// 38 ces gsungs te/ stong gsum gyi skye bo thams cad nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang la bkod pa'i dge ba dang*/ stong gsum gyi skye bo thams cad rang sangs rgyas bse ru lta bu'i dgra bcom pa'i rtogs pa phun sum tshogs pa la bkod pa'i dge ba dang*/ stong gsum gyi skye bo thams cad byang chub sems dpa'i sa skyon med pa la bkod pa'i dge ba dper mdzad nas/ de dag thams cad las lhag pa'i bsod nams kyi skal ba tshogs shin tu mu med pas mang po nyid kyi rdor ting des gnas ngan len spong ba de nas ni sangs rgyas nyid kyi bar na sgrib pa gzhan med pa des na bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin de ni rnam pa kun mkhyen pa nyid de ma thag tu thob par byed do//gnyis pa dmigs pa bdag po rnam pa bstan pa ni/ 'di yi dmigs pa dngos med de//bdag po dran pa yin par bzhed//rnam pa zhi nyid ces gsungs te/

bar chad med rtse 'di yi dmigs pa ni rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba dngos por med pa de yin la/ rnam mkhyen mngon du byed pa la phyogs pa'i bar chad med rtse'i bdag po ni ting nge 'dzin skyed byed kyi dran pa de yin par bzhed cing*/ rtse mo'i shes rnam ni spros pas dben pa'i zhi ba nyid do//gnyis pa spang bya log sgrub la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ — 'di la ni//rab tu smra rnams brgyud mar rgol// 39 zhes gsungs te/ dmigs pa dang rnam pa'i tshul 'di la ni chos can/ blo gros chung ba dngos po'i bag chags kyis rab tu bslad de smra ba rnams/ chos thams cad dngos por med na rnam mkhyen la brten pa'i chos dmigs pa la sogs pa'i chos bcu drug po rnams mi 'thad par 'gyur ro zhes brgyud mar rgol bar byed do//gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa ni/ dmigs pa 'thad dang 'di yi ni//ngo bo nyid nges gzung ba dang*//rnam kun mkhyen nyid ye shes dang*//dam pa'i don dang kun rdzob dang*// 40 sbyor dang dkon mchog gsum po dang*//thabs bcas thub pa'i rtogs pa dang*//phyin ci log ni lam bcas dang*//gnyen po mi mthun phyogs dag dang*// 41mtshan nyid dang ni sgom pa la//smra ba rnams kyi log rtog pa//rnam pa kun mkhyen nyid rten can//rnam pa bcu drug dag tu bzhed// 42ces gsungs te/ bar chad med pa'i rtse mo chos can/ dmigs pa'i yul 'thad pa ma yin par thal/ chos nyid dngos por med pa'i phyir zhe na/ don dam par der thal na 'dod la/ tha snyad du der thal/ rtags de'i phyir zer na/ khyab pa ma grub bo/ /don dam par na chos nyid dngos por med pa'i phyir/ tha snyad du der thal zer na khyab pa med par bstan pa dang*/ dmigs yul de yi ni ngo bo nyid rtogs par nges par bzung ba mi 'thad par thal/ dmigs yul med pa'i phyir zer na lan sngar dang 'dra'o/

/rnam pa kun mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes med par thal/ yul dngos po dang dngos med gnyis ka med pa'i phyir dang*/ dam pa'i don gyi bden pa dang kun rdzob kyi bden pa mi 'thad par thal/ de lta bu'i rnam 'jog gi dbye ba ma grub pa'i phyir dang*/ sems dpa'i sbyor ba med par thal/ phyin drug med pa'i phyir dang*/ dkon mchog gsum po med par thal/ rtogs par bya ba med pa dang*/ chos nyid ming tsam yin pa dang*/ spyod pa pha rol tu phyin pa drug med pa'i phyir/ sems dpa'i thabs yang dag pa dang bcas pa med par thal/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug med pa'i phyir/ thub pa'i rtogs pa med par thal/ dngos po dang dngos po med pa dang*/ gnyis ka rtogs pa med pa'i phyir dang*/ rtag pa dang*/ bde ba dang*/ bdag dang*/ gtsang bar 'dzin pa'i phyin ci log bzhi yod pa mi 'thad par thal/ mi rtag la sogs pa gnas tshul du zhugs pa'i phyir/ 'di'i skabs su kha cig sems dpa' chos can/ lta spyod phyin ci log tu thal/ rtag mi rtag gi spros pa byed pa'i phyir yang zer ro/ /rgyu theg chen gyi lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa med par thal/ 'bras bu byang chub mngon sum du mi byed pa'i phyir dang*/ mngon sum gtan mi byed pa'i phyir/ der thal zhe na/ ma grub la/ rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum ma byas kyi bar du mngon sum du mi byed pa'i phyir/ der thal zer na/ khyab pa med do/ /gnyen po dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs dag med par thal/ blang bya dang dor bya med pa'i phyir dang*/ chos thams cad kyi mtshan nyid med par thal/ mtshan gzhi med pa'i phyir dang ni/ lam sgom pa med par thal/ bsgom bya rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid med pa'i phyir zhes smra ba la/ lan ni dang po bzhin no//de ltar smra ba rnams kyi log par rtog pa yul rnam pa kun mkhyen pa nyid bar chad med pa'i rtse mo 'di la brten pa can gyi dbye ba rnam pa bcu drug yod pa dag tu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dag bzhed do//gnyis pa skabs kyi grangs brjod pas mjug bsdu ba ni/

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa las/ skabs lnga pa'o// //zhes gsungs te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan ces bya ba'i skabs lnga pa'i 'grel pa rdzogs so// //

skabs drug pa/ mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba/ gnyis pa brtan pa rgyu 'bras la gnyis/ rgyu mthar gyis pa dang*/ 'bras bu skad cig ma'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ mtshon byed kyi chos rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ skabs kyi grangs brjod pas mjug bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ sbyin pa shes rab bar dag dang*//sangs rgyas la sogs dran dang chos//dngos med ngo bo nyid kyis de//mthar gyis pa yi bya bar bzhed// 1ces gsungs te/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin nas/ shes rab kyi bar dag tu bsngos pa'i phar phyin drug dang*/ sangs rgyas dang*/ la sogs pas chos dang*/ dge 'dun dang*/ tshul khrims dang*/ gtong ba dang*/ lha rjes su dran pa drug dang*/ chos thams cad dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis sangs rgyas kyi sar 'gro ba'i lam de'i yongs su rdzogs pa mthar gyis pa'i bya bar bcom ldan 'das bzhed do//'dir phar phyin dang po gnyis dang*/ rjes dran bzhi pa dang lnga pa zlos pa dang*/ lha dang dkon mchog rjes dran zlos so snyam na/ de ltar min te/ bsdus don sgron mar/ sbyin dang tshul khrims gnyis dang ni//gtong dang tshul khrims dran pa yang*//dngos dang 'bras bu'i cha nas su//bstan pa zlos skyon med pa yin//lha dang dkon mchog dpang po dang*//rten tshul yin te zlos pa med/ /ces so//gnyis pa skabs kyi grangs brjod pas mjug bsdu ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa las/ skabs drug pa'o// //zhes gsungs te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan ces bya ba las/ skabs drug pa'i 'grel bshad rdzogs so// //skabs bdun pa/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba/ gnyis pa 'bras bu skad cig ma'i sbyor ba 'chad pa la gnyis/ mtshon byed kyi chos rgyas par bshad pa/ skabs kyi grangs brjod pas mjug bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la bzhi/

rnam smin min pa/ rnam smin/ mtshan nyid med pa/ gnyis med kyi skad cig ma'o//dang po la dngos dang*/ dpe gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sbyin pa la sogs re res kyang*//zag med chos kun bsdus pa'i phyir//thub pa'i skad cig gcig pa yi//rtogs pa 'di ni shes par bya// 1 zhes gsungs te/ sbyin pa dang tshul khrims la sogs sdud byed zag med kyi ye shes skad cig re res kyang bsdu bya zag med kyi chos kun bsdus te mngon du bya ba'i phyir/ thub pas sa bcu+u pa'i skad cig ma gcig pa'i ye shes rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes rtogs pa 'di ni shes par bya'o//gnyis pa dpe ni/ ji ltar skyes bus zo chun rgyud//rdog thabs gcig gis bskyod pa na//thams cad gcig car 'gul ba ltar//skad cig gcig shes de bzhin no// 2 zhes gsungs te/ dpe ji ltar na/ skyes bus zo chun gyi rgyud la rdog thabs gcig gis bskyod pa na/ zo chun thams cad gcig car 'gul ba ltar rgyun mtha'i ye shes skad cig gcig la zag med kyi chos thams cad shes pa'ang de bzhin no//gnyis pa rnam par smin pa'i skad cig ma ni/ gang tshe chos dkar thams cad kyi//rang bzhin shes rab pha rol phyin//rnam smin chos nyid gnas skabs skyes//de tshe skad cig gcig ye shes// 3 zhes gsungs te/ rgyun mthar bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob pa gang gi tshe chos dkar po thams cad kyi rang bzhin rgyal ba'i yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa phyag rgya chen po yongs rdzogs kyi chos nyid gdod ma nas rnam par smin pa lhun grub dri bral gyi chos nyid gnas skabs gang du dri ma dang bral bas skye bar snang ba ltar gyur pa de'i tshe de nyid yongs rdzogs rtogs byed kyi skad cig ma gcig gis gcig car du rtogs byed kyi ye shes te sbyor ba'o//gsum pa mtshan nyid med pa'i skad cig ma ni/ sbyin pa la sogs spyod pa yis//chos kun rmi lam 'drar gnas nas//chos rnams mtshan nyid med pa nyid//skad cig ma ni gcig gis rtogs//

4zhes gsungs te/ sems dpas dus de la sbyin pa la sogs pa'i spyod pa mi 'dor ba'i sgo nas chos kun rmi lam dang 'dra bar rtogs pa la gnas nas/ chos dang chos nyid rnams kyi gnas tshul thams cad mtshan nyid med pa nyid du skad cig ma'i sbyor ba ni gcig gis rtogs nus te rnam mkhyen mngon du byed do//bzhi pa gnyis su med pa'i skad cig ma ni/ rmi lam dang ni de mthong nyid//gnyis kyi tshul du mi mthong ltar//chos rnams gnyis su med pa yi//de nyid skad cig gcig gis mthong*// 5zhes gsungs te/ dper yul na rmi lam dang ni yul can de mthong ba de dag nyid gnyis kyi tshul du mi mthong ba rtog pa gcig gi ngo bo yin pa ltar/ 'od gsal ngo bo nyid sku'i chos rnams sgro 'dogs skur 'debs dang bral ba gnyis su med pa'i ye shes skad cig de kho na nyid kyi skad cig gcig gis gnyis su med par mngon du mthong nas de ma thag par mngon par rdzogs par byang chub byed yin no//gnyis pa skabs kyi grangs brjod pas mjug bsdu ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa las/ skabs bdun pa'o// //zhes gsungs te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan ces bya ba las/ skabs bdun pa'i 'grel bshad rdzogs so// // skabs brgyad pa/ 'bras bu chos sku/ gsum pa 'bras bu chos sku 'chad pa la gnyis/ mtshon byed kyi chos rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ skabs kyi grangs brjod pas mjug bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ ngo bo nyid sku bshad pa dang*/ sku gsum so sor bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ thub pa'i ngo bo nyid sku ni//zag pa med pa'i chos gang dag/thob gyur rnam kun rnam dag pa//de dag rang bzhin mtshan nyid can// 1 zhes gsungs te/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po'i ngo bo nyid sku ni/

zag pa med pa de bzhin gshegs pa kho na'i khyad par gyi chos gang su dag ci mchis pa de snyed cig thob par 'gyur ba'i ngo bo spang bya bag chags dang bcas pa rnam pa kun tu spangs pas rnam par dag pa de dag ni/ dag pa gnyis dang ldan pa 'ba' zhig pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rang bzhin dang*/ ngo bo mtshon pa'i mtshan nyid can yin no//gnyis pa sku gsum so sor bshad pa la bzhi/ chos sku/ longs sku/ sprul sku/ mdzad pa phrin las bshad pa'o/ /dang po la drug /chos rnams kyi rnam pa bshad pa/ nyan thos kyi nyon mongs pa med pa las khyad par/ smon nas mkhyen pa'i khyad par/ phrin las 'jug pa'i tshul/ ma nges pa spang ba/ khyab pa dang rtag pa'i don no//dang po ni/ byang chub phyogs mthun tshad med dang*//rnam par thar dang mthar gyis ni// snyoms 'jug dgu yi bdag nyid dang*//zad par bcu yi bdag nyid dang*// 2 zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched ni//rab tu dbye bas rnam brgyad dang*//nyon mongs med dang smon mkhyen dang*//mngon shes so so yang dag rig/ 3 rnam pa thams cad dag bzhi dang*//dbang bcu dang ni stobs bcu dang*// mi 'jigs pa ni bzhi dag dang*//bsrung ba med pa rnam gsum dang*// 4 dran pa nyer gzhag rnam gsum dang*//bsnyel ba mi mnga'i chos nyid dang*// bag chags yang dag bcom pa dang*//skye la thugs rje chen po dang*// 5 thub pa kho na'i ma 'dres chos//bco brgyad bshad pa gang yin dang*//rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid dang*//chos kyi sku zhes brjod pa yin// 6 zhes gsungs te/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos dang mthun pa so bdun dang*/ tshad med bzhi dang*/ rnam par thar pa brgyad dang*/ mthar gyis pa'i snyoms 'jug dgu'i bdag nyid dang*/ zad par bcu'i bdag nyid dang*/ zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched ni rab tu dbye ba rnam brgyad dang*/ nyon mongs med pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ smon nas yongs su mkhyen pa dang*/ mngon par shes pa drug dang*/

so sor yang dag pa'i rig pa bzhi dang*/ rnam pa thams cad yongs su dag pa bzhi dang*/ dbang bcu dang ni stobs rnam pa bcu dang*/ mi 'jigs pa ni rnam pa bzhi dag dang*/ srung ba med pa rnam pa gsum dang*/ dran pa nye bar bzhag pa rnam pa gsum dang*/ bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba'i chos nyid dang*/ bag chags yang dag par bcom pa dang*/ skye bo la thugs rje chen po dang*/ thub pa kho na'i ma 'dres pa'i chos bco brgyad bshad pa gang yin pa dang*/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang*/ de ltar nyi shu rtsa gcig po la chos kyi sku zhes yongs su brjod pa yin no//gnyis pa nyan thos kyi nyon mongs pa med pa las khyad par 'chad pa ni/ nyan thos nyon mongs med pa'i lta//mi yi nyon mongs yongs spong nyid// grong sogs su de'i nyon mongs rnams//rgyun gcod rgyal ba'i nyon mongs med// 7 ces gsungs te/ nyan thos kyi nyon mongs pa med pa ni/ rang nyid kyi rgyud la de skye ba'i rkyen med pa tsam gyi khyad par du blta zhing*/ nyan thos de'i sgo nas pha rol mi'i nyon mongs yongs su spong ba tsam nyid yin no//sangs rgyas kyi nyon mongs med pa'i ting nge 'dzin grong khyer la sogs pa rnams su rang rgyud la nyon mongs pa yod med dang*/ gzhan gyi nyon mongs skye ba'i dmigs rten byed mi byed la brtag mi dgos par gdul bya de'i nyon mongs ma lus pa rnams rgyun gcod par mdzad pas rgyal ba'i nyon mongs pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ rang gzhan gnyis ka'i rgyud kyi nyon mongs 'joms par mdzad pas khyad par du 'phags so//gsum pa smon nas mkhyen pa'i khyad par ni/ sangs rgyas smon nas mkhyen pa ni//lhun gyis grub dang chags spangs dang*// thogs pa med dang rtag gnas dang*//dri ba kun lan 'debs par bzhed// 8 ces gsungs te/ sangs rgyas kyi smon nas mkhyen pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni lhun gyis grub pa dang*/ chags pa spangs pa dang*/

thogs pa med pa dang*/ rtag par gnas pa dang*/ 'dri ba kun lan 'debs par bzhed ces pa rnams so//bzhi pa phrin las 'jug pa'i tshul ni/ rgyu ni yongs su smin gyur nas//gang dang gang la gang dang ni// gang tshe bya ba phan gyur pa//de dang de la de snang ngo*// 9 zhes gsungs te/ sangs rgyas mthong ba'i rgyu dad pa la sogs pa ni/ yongs su smin par gyur nas sku la sogs pa'i phrin las gdul bya gang dang gang la/ 'dul ba'i rnam pa gang dang ni gang gi tshe 'dul ba'i bya ba gdul bya la phan par gyur pa de'i tshe gdul bya de dang de la sangs rgyas de dang de'i gzugs de snang ngo*// lnga pa ma nges pa spang ba ni/ lha yi rgyal pos char phab kyang*//sa bon mi rung mi 'khrungs ltar// sangs rgyas rnams ni byung gyur kyang*//skal pa med pas bzang mi myong*// 10 zhes gsungs te/ dpe ji ltar na/ lha yi rgyal pos phyogs ris med par char phab kyang mes tshig pa lta bu sa bon mi rung ba la 'bras bu mi 'khrungs pa ltar/ sangs rgyas rnams ni 'jig rten du byung nas bdud rtsi'i char phab par gyur kyang*/ chos kyi skal ba med pas bstan pa bdud rtsi'i ro bzang po mi myong ba'o//'dir char phab pa'i don ni/ phal chen nas klu kho nas char 'bebs par bshad cing*/ 'dul ba lung las/ rgyal chen ris bzhi'i lha rnams kyis gos rgya mtshor bcug ste sprugs te char 'bab par bshad/ gser gling pas brgya byin gyis 'bebs par bshad pas gzhung dang mthun no//drug pa khyab pa dang rtag pa'i don ni/ de ltar mdzad pa rgya che'i phyir//sangs rgyas khyab par nges par brjod// de nyid zad pa med pa'i phyir//rtag pa zhes kyang brjod pa yin// 11 zhes gsungs te/ skal med la mi snang yang chos sku de yul dus thams cad par rtag par bshad pa de ltar sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa rgya che ba'i phyir/ sangs rgyas min pa med pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyis ma khyab pa med pas khyab par nges par brjod pa dang*/

chos sku de nyid 'dus byas su ma grub cing*/ mi rtag pa min pas zad pa med pa'i phyir rtag pa zhes kyang brjod do//des na sh+lauka gsum po 'di mdo dang dngos su sbyar rgyu ma byung yang*/ tshigs bcad phyi ma 'di ye shes chos sku khyab rtag yin pa'i rtsa sbyor bkod nas/ de khyab rtag yin kyang de khyab rtag tu snang mi snang gnyis yod pa tshigs bcad dang pos bstan nas/ de mi snang yang de khyab rtag min mi dgos pa tshigs bcad bar pa'i steng du mthun dper bstan pa yin no//gnyis pa longs sku la lnga/ mdor bstan/ mtshan bzang po bshad pa/ ji ltar 'grub pa/ rgyu mdo la sbyar ba/ dpe byad bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mtshan ni sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*//dpe byad brgyad cu'i bdag nyid 'di// theg chen nye bar longs spyod phyir//thub pa'i longs spyod rdzogs skur bzhed//12 ces gsungs te/ 'og min na bzhugs pa'i longs sku chen po chos can/ mtshan ni sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dpe byad brgyad cu'i bdag nyid can 'di'i skus ni theg pa chen po'i chos kho na la nye bar longs spyod pa'i phyir/ thub pa'i longs spyod rdzogs skur bcom ldan 'das bzhed do//gnyis pa mtshan bzang bshad pa ni/ phyag zhabs 'khor lo'i mtshan dang rus sbal zhabs// phyag dang zhabs sor dra bas 'brel ba dang*// phyag ni zhabs bcas 'jam zhing gzhon sha chags// 'di yi sku ni bdun dag mtho ba dang*// 13 zhes gsungs te/ mtshan bzang so gnyis po re re bzhin bshad na/ sngon slob lam du bla ma rnams la skyel ba dang bsu ba la sogs pa'i rgyus phyag dang zhabs 'khor lo'i mtshan dang ldan pa nyid dang*/ sngon sdom pa yang dag par blangs pa la brten pa nyid kyis rus sbal bzhin du zhabs shin tu gnas pa nyid dang*/ sngon bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi bsten pas phyag dang zhabs bcas kyi sor mo ngang pa'i rgyal po lta bur dra bas 'brel ba nyid dang*/ sngon bza' ba dang bca' ba la sogs pa gya nom pa sbyin pas phyag dang ni zhabs bcas 'jam zhing gzhon sha chags pa nyid dang*/

sngon ldag pa la sogs pa shin tu gya nom pa byin pas thub pa 'di yi sku'i ni phyag gi skyong gnyis dang zhabs kyi skyong gnyis dang thal gong gi skyong gnyis dang ltag pa'i skyong phyogs mtho ba'i phyir bdun po dag mtho ba nyid dang*/ sor mo ring dang rting yangs sku che drang*//zhabs 'bur mi mngon spu ni gyen du phyogs// byin pa e na ya'i 'dra phyag ring mdzes// mdoms kyi sba ba sbubs su nub pa'i mchog/ 14 sngon gsad par bya ba las thar par byas pas sor mo ring ba nyid dang*/ sngon srog gi 'tsho ba la phan btags pa nyid kyis rting pa yangs pa nyid dang*/ sngon srog gcod pa spangs pa nyid kyis sku che zhing drang ba nyid dang*/ sngon dge ba'i chos rgyud la yang dag par blangs pas zhabs long bu mi mngon pa nyid dang*/ sngon dge ba'i chos yang dag par blangs pa spel bas sku'i ba spu ni gyen du phyogs pa nyid dang*/ sngon rigs pa dang bzo la sogs pa la gus par byas te yon la sogs pa mgu bar bya ste byin pas byin pa ri dwags en+ya'i 'dra ba dang*/ sngon nor bdog pa la slong ba po'i skye bo'i phyir dngos po'i ched du ma spangs pas bzhengs nas ma btud par pus mor sleb pa'i phyag ring zhing mdzes pa nyid dang*/ sngon skye bo thams cad tshangs par spyod pa yang dag par len du 'jug pa dang*/ gsang bar 'os pa'i gsang tshig bsrungs pas mdoms kyi sba ba sbubs su nub pa'i mchog nyid dang*/ pags pa gser mdog pags pa srab pa dang*// spu ni re re nas g.yas legs 'khrungs dang*// zhal mdzod spus brgyan ro stod seng ge 'dra// 'di yi dpung pa'i mgo zlum thal gong rgyas/ 15 sngon gding ba gya nom pa byin pas pags pa gser mdog 'dra ba nyid dang*/ sngon khang bzang la sogs pa dam pa byin pas pags pa srab pa nyid dang*/ sngon 'du 'dzi la sogs pa yongs su spangs pas spu ni re re nas g.yas phyogs su 'khyil ba dang*/

sngon skye bo bla ma thams cad gnas ji lta ba bzhin du bkod pas zhal ras mdzod spus brgyan pa nyid dang*/ sngon rnam pa thams cad du khas drag gi tshig gis khyad du ma bsad pas ro stod seng ge'i 'dra ba nyid dang*/ sngon snyan par smra ba dang legs par smra ba'i rjes su mthun par byas pas 'di yi dpung pa'i mgo shin tu zlum pa nyid dang*/ sngon sman la sogs pa byin pas thal gong rgyas pa nyid dang*/ 'di la ro mi zhim pa ro mchog snang*// sku ni n+ya gro dha ltar chu zheng gab// gtsug tor dbur ldan ljags ring mdzes pa dang*// tshangs dbyangs 'gram pa seng ge'i 'dra dang tshems/ 16 shin tu dkar dang tshems mnyam thags bzang dang*// grangs ni bzhi bcu tham par tshang ba dang*// spyan ni mthon mthing spyan rdzi ba mchog gi/'dra ba 'di dag sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan// 17 sngon skye bo nad pa'i g.yog byas pas 'di la ro mi zhim pa ro bro ba'i mchog tu snang ba nyid dang*/ sngon nags tshal dang kun dga' ra ba la sogs pa byed pa yang dag par len du bcug pas sku ni shing n+ya gro dha ltar chu zheng gab pa nyid dang*/ sngon gtsug lag khang la sogs pa lhag par byin pas gtsug tor dbur ldan pa nyid dang*/ sngon 'jam po la sogs pa gsungs pas ljags ring zhing mdzes pa nyid dang*/ sngon 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can thams cad la dam pa'i chos go bar byas pas tshangs pa'i dbyangs nyid dang*/ sngon tshig 'khyal pa spangs pas 'gram pa seng ge'i 'dra ba nyid

dang*/ sngon skye bo thams cad la legs par bkur ba la sogs pas tshems shin tu dkar ba nyid dang*/ sngon 'tsho ba rnam par dag pa nyid kyis tshems tshad mnyam pa nyid dang*/ sngon bden pa'i tshig kun tu spyad pas tshems thags bzang ba nyid dang*/ sngon phra ma'i tshig spangs pas tshems kyi grangs ni bzhi bcu tham pa tshang ba nyid dang*/ sngon sems can thams cad la bu gcig pa dang 'dra bar bltas pas spyan ni mthon mthing nyid dang*/ sngon khong khro ba la sogs pa med par bltas pas spyan gyi rdzi ma ba mchog gi rdzi ma lta bu nyid kyis so//gsum pa ji ltar 'grub pa ni/ 'di la mtshan ni gang gang gi/sgrub par byed pa'i rgyu gang yin// de dang de ni rab rdzogs pas//mtshan ni 'di dag yang dag 'grub// 18ces gsungs te/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'di la 'bras bu mtshan ni gang dang gang gi sgrub par byed pa'i rgyu gang dang gang yin pa de dang de ni rab tu rdzogs pa sngon du song bas rgyu mtshan de'i phyir mtshan ni 'di dag yang dag par 'grub pa yin no//bzhi pa rgyu mdo dang sbyar ba ni/ bla ma skyel la sogs pa dang*//yang dag blangs pa brtan pa dang*// bsdu ba bsten dang gya nom pa'i//dngos po sbyin dang gsad bya ba// 19 thar bar byed dang dge ba ni//yang dag blangs pa spel la sogs// sgrub byed rgyu yi mtshan nyid de//mdo las ji skad 'byung ba bzhin// 20 ces gong du bkral zin to//lnga pa dpe byad bshad pa ni/ ¿bcu tshan dang po ni/¿thub pa'i sen mo zangs mdog dang*//mdog snum mtho dang sor mo rnams// zlum rgyas byin gyis phra ba dang*//rtsa mi mngon dang mdud pa med// 21long bu mi mngon zhabs mnyam dang*// 'du byed thams cad la 'dod chags dang bral ba nyid kyis sen mo zangs kyi mdog lta bu nyid dang*/ sems can thams cad la phan pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa nyid kyis sen mo'i mdog snum pa nyid dang*/ rigs kyi mchog las skyes pas sen mo mtho ba nyid dang*/

tshul kha na ma tho ba med pa nyid kyis sor mo rnams zlum pa nyid dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsags pa nyid kyis sor mo rnams rgyas pa nyid dang*/ yang dag par mthar gyis zhugs pa nyid kyis sor mo rnams byin gyis phra ba nyid dang*/ lus la sogs pa'i las dang 'tsho ba rab tu bsrungs pa nyid kyis rtsa mi mngon pa nyid dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i mdud pa 'grol ba nyid kyis rtsa mdud med pa nyid dang*/ shin tu sbas pa'i chos kyi blo gros can nyid kyis long bu mi mngon pa nyid dang*/ bgrod dka' ba'i gnas thams cad las skye bo sgrol bar mdzad pa nyid kyis zhabs mi mnyam pa med pa dang*/ ¿bcu tshan gnyis pa ni/¿seng ge glang chen bya dang ni//khyu mchog stabs gshegs g.yas phyogs dang*//mdzes gshegs drang dang 'khril bag chags// 22byi dor byas 'dra rim par 'tsham//mi zil gyis gnon pa la mkhas pa nyid kyis seng ge'i stabs su gshegs pa nyid dang*/ klu zil gyis gnon pa la mkhas pa nyid kyis glang po che'i stabs su gshegs pa nyid dang*/ nam mkha' la gshegs par mkhas pa nyid kyis bya ngang pa'i stabs su gshegs pa nyid dang ni/ skyes bu'i khyu mchog tu mkhas pa nyid kyis khyu mchog gi stabs su gshegs pa nyid dang*/ skor phyogs kyi lam dang mthun par gshegs pa nyid kyis g.yas phyogs su ldog cing gshegs pa nyid dang*/ mdzes par mkhas pa nyid kyis mdzes par gshegs pa nyid dang*/ rtag tu sems gya gyur mi mnga' ba nyid kyis drang por gshegs pa nyid dang*/ yon tan yang dag par brjod par mdzad pa nyid kyis sku 'khril bag chags pa nyid dang*/ sdig pa'i chos dang ma 'bags pa nyid kyis sku byi dor byas pa dang 'dra ba nyid dang*/ gdul bya dang 'tshams pa'i chos ston par mdzad pa nyid kyis sku rim par 'tshams pa nyid dang*/ ¿bcu tshan gsum pa ni/¿gtsang dang 'jam dang dag pa'i sku//mtshan ni yongs su rdzogs pa dang*//sku yi kho lag yangs shing bzang*//

23 gom snyoms pa dang spyan gnyis ni//dag dang gzhon sha can nyid dang*//sku zhum med dang rgyas pa dang*//sku la sogs pa kun tu spyod pa gtsang ba'i phyir sku rnam par dag pa nyid dang*/ thugs thugs rje can gyi phyir sku 'jam pa nyid dang*/ thugs rnam par dag pa'i phyir rnam par dag pa'i sku nyid dang*/ chos 'dul ba yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir mtshan ni yongs su rdzogs pa nyid dang*/ yangs shing mdzes pa'i yon tan rdzogs pa'i phyir sku'i kho lag yangs shing bzang ba nyid dang*/ thams cad la thugs snyoms pa'i phyir gom pa snyoms pa nyid dang*/ rnam par dag pa'i chos ston pa'i phyir spyan rnam par dag pa nyid dang*/ chos gos rnyed sla bar ston pa'i phyir sku shin tu gzhon sha can nyid dang*/ thugs rtag tu ma zhum pa'i phyir sku zhum pa med pa nyid dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba yang dag par 'phags pa'i phyir sku rgyas pa nyid dang*/ ¿bcu tshan bzhi pa ni/¿shin tu grims pa'i sku nyid dang*// 24 yan lag shin tu rnam 'byes dang*// gzigs pa sgrib med dag pa dang*//dku zlum skabs phyin ma rnyongs dang*// phyang nge ba dang lte ba ni// 25 zab dang g.yas phyogs 'khyil ba dang*// kun nas blta na sdug pa dang*//yang srid zad pa nyid kyi phyir shin tu grims pa'i sku nyid dang*/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba shin tu rnam par phye ba ston par mdzad pa nyid kyis yan lag dang nying lag shin tu rnam par 'byes pa nyid dang*/ tshig gi don shin tu rnam par dag pa ston pas gzigs pa rab rib med cing rnam par dag pa nyid dang*/ slob ma tshul khrims phun sum tshogs par gyur pa nyid kyis sku zlum pa nyid dang*/ 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma sbags pa nyid kyis dku'i skabs phyin pa dang*/ nga rgyal gyi 'gying bag bcom pa nyid kyis sku rnyongs pa med pa nyid dang*/ chos zad pa rnam par bzlog pa nyid kyis phyal phyang nge ba nyid dang*/ chos zab mo rtogs pa nyid kyis lte ba ni zab pa nyid dang*/
