slob ma mthun par 'dzin par gyur ba nyid kyis lte ba g.yas phyogs su 'khyil ba nyid dang*/ 'khor kun nas mdzes par gyur pa nyid kyis sku'i cha kun nas mdzes pa nyid dang*/ ¿bcu tshan lnga pa ni/¿kun spyod gtsang dang sku la ni//sme ba gnag bag med pa dang*// 26 phyag ni shing bal ltar 'jam dang*//phyag ris mdangs yod zab ring dang*//zhal ni ha cang mi ring dang*//mchu ni bim+pa ltar dmar dang*// 27 ljags mnyen pa dang srab pa dang*// thugs gtsang ba nyid kyis kun tu spyod pa gtsang ba nyid dang*/ dus ma yin pa'i 'gro ba 'dul ba'i chos dang bral ba nyid kyis sku la ni sme ba dang gnag bag med pa nyid dang*/ lus la sogs pa zo mdog bde ba thob pa'i chos ston par mdzad pa nyid kyis phyag ni shing bal ltar shin tu 'jam pa nyid dang*/ mdangs yod pa'i dge sbyong chen po brnyes pa nyid kyis phyag g-i ṛ mo mdangs yod pa nyid dang*/ chos zab mo la gnas pa nyid kyis phyag gi ri mo zab cing ring ba nyid dang*/ phyi rjes su yang dag par yongs su dag pa'i chos ston par mdzad pa nyid kyis phyag gi ri mo ring ba nyid dang*/ bslab pa rab tu mang po kun ston par mdzad pa nyid kyis zhal ni ha cang mi ring ba nyid dang*/ 'jig rten thams cad gzugs brnyan dang 'dra bar rtogs pa nyid kyis mchu ni bim pa ltar dmar ba nyid dang*/ tshig 'jam pos 'dul ba nyid kyis ljags mnyen pa nyid dang*/ yon tan 'thad pa mang ba nyid kyis ljags srab pa nyid dang*/ ¿bcu tshan drug pa ni/¿dmar dang 'brug gi sgra nyid dang*//gsung mnyen 'jam dang mche ba zlum// rno dang dkar dang mnyam pa dang*// 28 byin gyis phra dang shangs mtho dang*// mchog tu dag pa dag dang ni//chos 'dul ba byis pa'i skye bo chags pa can gyis gting dpag dka' ba nyid kyis ljags dmar ba nyid dang*/ bsnyengs pa thams cad mi mnga' ba nyid kyis 'brug gi sgra dang ldan pa nyid dang*/ snyan pa la sogs pa gsung ba nyid kyis gsung snyan zhing mnyen la 'jam pa nyid dang*/

srid par kun tu sbyor ba bsdams pa nyid kyis mche ba zlum pa nyid dang*/ skye bo gdul dka' ba 'dul bar mdzad pa nyid kyis mche ba rno ba nyid dang*/ chos 'dul ba shin tu dka' ba nyid kyis mche ba dkar ba nyid dang*/ mnyam pa'i sa la gnas pa nyid kyis mche ba mnyam pa nyid dang*/ mthar gyis mngon par rtogs pa yang dag par rab tu ston par mdzad pa nyid kyis mche ba byin gyis phra ba nyid dang*/ shes rab mchog la gnas pa nyid kyis shangs mtho ba nyid dang*/ skye bo gtsang ma phun sum tshogs pa nyid kyis shangs mchog tu dag pa dag dang ni/ ¿bcu tshan bdun pa ni/¿spyan yangs pa dang rdzi ma stug/pad+ma'i 'dab ma 'dra ba dang*// 29 smin tshugs ring dang 'jam pa dang*//snum dang spu ni mnyam pa dang*//phyag ring rgyas dang snyan mnyam dang*//nyams pa rnam par spangs pa dang*// 30 chos shin tu rgya che ba'i phyir spyan yangs pa nyid dang*/ sems can gyi tshogs drangs pa nyid kyis rdzi ma stug pa nyid dang*/ 'gro ba gzhon nu ma thams cad mngon par mgu ba nyid kyis spyan dkar nag 'byes shing pad+ma'i 'dab ma rangs pa 'dra ba nyid dang*/ rtag tu phyi rjes su gzigs pa nyid kyis smin tshugs ring ba nyid dang*/ chos 'dul ba 'jam po la mkhas pa nyid kyis smin ma 'jam pa nyid dang*/ thugs kyi rgyud dge bas brlan pa nyid kyis smin ma snum pa nyid dang*/ kun tu skyon gzigs pa nyid kyis smin ma'i spu mnyam pa nyid dang*/ mchog tu gnod pa bzlog par mdzad pa nyid kyis phyag ring zhing rgyas pa nyid dang*/ 'dod chags la sogs pa'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba nyid kyis snyan mnyam pa nyid dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi dge ba'i rgyud ma nyams par mdzad pa nyid kyis snyan gyi dbang po nyams pa rnam par spangs pa nyid dang*/ ¿bcu tshan brgyad pa ni/¿dpral ba legs par 'byes pa dang*//dbyes che ba dang dbu rgyas dang*//dbu skra bung ba ltar gnag dang*//stug dang 'jam dang ma 'dzings dang*//

31 mi bshor dri zhim skyes bu yi//yid ni 'phrog par byed pa dang*//dpal gyi be'u dang bkra shis ni//g.yung drung 'khyil bas brgyan pa ste// sangs rgyas dpe byad bzang por bzhed// 32lta bas byas pa thams cad kyis gzhan du mi 'gyur ba nyid kyis dpral ba legs par 'byes pa nyid dang*/ smra ba thams cad 'joms par mdzad pa nyid kyis dpral ba'i dbyes che ba nyid dang*/ smon lam gyi mchog yongs su rdzogs pa nyid kyis dbu shin tu rgyas pa nyid dang*/ yul gyi dga' ba bzlog par mdzad pa nyid kyis dbu skra bung ba ltar gnag pa nyid dang*/ mthong ba dang sgom pas spang bar bya ba'i bag la nyal spangs pa'i phyir dbu skra stug pa nyid dang*/ bstan pa'i blo 'jam pos yongs su shes pa nyid kyis dbu skra 'jam pa nyid dang*/ thugs 'dod chags la sogs pas ma 'khrugs pa nyid kyis dbu skra ma 'dzings pa nyid dang*/ rtag tu tshig mi rtsub pa nyid kyis dbu skra mi bshor ba nyid dang*/ byang chub kyi yan lag gi me tog bkram pa nyid kyis dbu skra dri zhim pa nyid dang*/ rnam pa thams cad du mdzes par gyur pa nyid kyis phyag dang zhabs dpal gyi be'u dang bkra shis dang ni g.yung drung 'khyil pas brgyan pa ste sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang por bzhed do//gsum pa sprul sku ni/ gang gis srid pa ji srid bar//'gro la phan pa sna tshogs dag/ mnyam du mdzad pa'i sku de ni//thub pa'i sprul sku rgyun mi 'chad// 33 ces gsungs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa sna tshogs pa tha dad pa gang gis dus srid pa ji srid kyi bar du 'gro ba ste skye rgu'i tshogs kyi mtha' ma zad kyi bar du sangs rgyas kyis phan pa'ang sna tshogs su bsgrub par mdzad pa dag lhan cig tu'am/ mnyam pa nyid du mdzad pa'i sku de ni thub pa'i sprul sku ste rgyun mi 'chad par 'dod do//bzhi pa mdzad pa phrin las la gsum ste/ 'jug yul rgyun mi 'chad pa dang*/

phrin las nyi shu rtsa bdun rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ de bzhin 'khor ba ji srid 'di'i//las ni rgyun mi 'chad par 'dod//ces gsungs te/ chos nyid kyi sku rgyun chad med pa de bzhin du 'khor ba ji srid par 'di'ang rgyun 'chad med pa yin te/ sems can rgyun chad med pa gang zhig de rgyun chad med na des bsags pa'i las ni rgyun mi 'chad par 'dod pa'i phyir chos sku'i phrin las ni ji srid pa'i sems can de srid la 'jug pa yin no//gnyis pa phrin las nyi shu rtsa bdun rgyas par bshad pa ni/ 'gro rnams zhi ba'i las dang ni//bsdu rnam bzhi la 'god pa dang*// 34 kun nas nyon mongs bcas pa yi//rnam par byang ba rtogs pa dang*// sems can rnams don ji bzhin gyi//don dang pha rol phyin drug dang*// 35zhes gsungs te/ dang por 'gro ba bzang po dang bzang po ma yin pa la mngon par zhen pa med par gnas pa'i mtshan nyid 'gro ba rab tu zhi ba'i phrin las mdzad pa dang ni/ sbyin pa la sogs pa bsdu ba'i dngos po rnam pa bzhi la 'god pa dang*/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs kun nas nyon mongs pa dang bcas pa yi gnyen po rnam par byang ba dag la rim bzhin dor ba dang blang bar bya ba'i sgo nas rtogs par mdzad pa dang*/ sgyu ma mkhan bzhin du rjes su chags pa la sogs pas rnam par dben pa nyid kyis sems can rnams kyi don te/ gzhan gyi don byams pa la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid ji lta ba bzhin gyi don la bkod pa dang*/ rjes la rang gi don 'khor gsum rnam par dag pas rab tu phye ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug la goms pa dang*/ sangs rgyas lam dang rang bzhin gyis//stong pa nyid dang gnyis zad dang*// brda dang dmigs pa med pa dang*//lus can rnams ni yongs smin dang*// 36 byang chub sems dpa'i lam dang ni//mngon par zhen pa zlog pa dang*// de'i 'og tu rang dang gzhan gyi don gyi mtshan nyid sangs rgyas kyi lam ste dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam dang*/

de nas chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong pa nyid goms pa dang*/ de'i rjes la sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la brten nas sa dang po chos kyi dbyings kun tu 'gro ba rtogs pa'i mtshan nyid gnyis zad pa'i chos dang*/ de nas tshogs yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgyur gyur pas sa gnyis pa la sogs par tshul khrims la sogs pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos thams cad brdar btags pa'i shes pa la 'god pa dang*/ de bzhin du rim gyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brten nas sa drug pa la shes pa dang shes bya'i dngos por mngon par ma zhen pa'i mtshan nyid kyis chos thams cad dmigs pa med pa la dang*/ de'i 'og tu sa bdun pa la thabs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i stobs kyis lus can rnams ni yongs su smin par byed pa dang*/ de nas stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i stobs kyis sa brgyad pa la nyan thos la sogs pa dang thun mong ma yin pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i lam dang ni/ de nas de nyid la chos thams cad la mngon par zhen pa zlog pa dang*/ byang chub thob dang sangs rgyas zhing*//rnam par dag dang nges pa dang*// 37 sems can don ni tshad med dang*//sangs rgyas bsten sogs yon tan dang*// byang chub yan lag las rnams ni//chud mi za dang bden mthong dang*// 38 de'i rjes la sa dgu pa la smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mthus byang chub thob pa dang*/ de'i 'og tu ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i stobs kyis sa bcu pa la sangs rgyas kyi zhing sna tshogs pa rnam par dag pa la bkod pa dang*/ yang de nyid la skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'i rang gi ngo bo yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu so sor nges pa dang*/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can gyi don ni tshad med pa dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du sangs rgyas kyi drung du nye bar 'gro zhing bsten pa la sogs pa'i yon tan la bkod pa dang*/ de lta bu'i rim pas yang de nyid la khyad par gyi lam gyi rang gi ngo bo byang chub mtha' dag 'dren par byed pa'i chos kyi mtshan nyid byang chub kyi yan lag dang*/

las dang 'bras bur 'brel ba rnams ni chud mi za ba dang*/ dngos po thams cad yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin bden pa mthong ba dang*/ phyin ci log ni spangs pa dang*//de gzhi med pa'i tshul dang ni//rnam par byang dang tshogs dang ni//'dus byas 'dus ma byas pa la// 39 tha dad yongs su mi shes dang*//mya ngan 'das la 'god pa ste//phyin ci log ni thams cad spangs pa dang*/ phyin ci log de gzhi med par spangs pa'i tshul dang ni/ rang bzhin gyis yongs su dag pa'i mtshan nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par byang ba dang*/ dri ma thams cad dang bral ba'i rnam par byang ba'i rgyu'i tshogs dang ni/ stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid kyis 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas pa la tha dad par yongs su mi shes pa la bkod pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa la mya ngan las 'das pa la 'god par mdzad pa ste de rnams so//gsum pa don bsdu ba ni/ chos kyi sku yi phrin las ni//rnam pa nyi shu bdun du bzhed// 40 ces gsungs te/ de ltar na chos kyi sku bzhin du 'di yi phrin las rnam pa nyi shu rtsa bdun du yang 'khor ba ji srid par bzhed pas mdzad pa yin no//gnyis pa skabs kyi grangs brjod pas mjug bsdu ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa las/ skabs brgyad pa'o// //zhes gsungs te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan ces bya ba las/ skabs brgyad pa'i 'grel pa'o// //gnyis pa bar ma la dad pa'i gang zag la don drug tu bstan pa ni/ mtshan nyid de yi sbyor ba dang*//de rab de yi go rim dang*// de mtha' de yi rnam smin ni//don bsdus gzhan te rnam pa drug/ 1 zhes gsungs te/ rgyal ba'i yum don mtshon byed kyi dbang du byas nas mtshan nyid mkhyen pa gsum dang*/ de mngon du bya ba'i rnam kun mngon rdzogs kyi sbyor ba dang*/

sbyor ba de thabs kyi sgo nas rgyud la sbyar ba de rab tu gyur pa rtse sbyor dang*/ sbyor ba de'i go rim gyi dbang du byas nas mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ de skad cig ma tha ma'i dbang du byas nas skad cig ma'i sbyor ba bzhi dang*/ sbyor ba de'i rnam smin chos kyi sku dang bcas pas ni sher phyin gyi don thams cad bsdus te 'di ni bsdus tshul snga ma las gzhan te rnam pa drug tu bsdus pa yin no//gsum pa bsdus pa la dad pa'i gang zag la gsum du bsdus te bstan pa ni/ yul ni rnam pa gsum po rgyu//sbyor ba bzhi yi bdag nyid dang*// chos sku phrin las 'bras bu ni//don bsdus gzhan te rnam pa gsum//2 zhes gsungs te/ 'jug pa'i yul ni mkhyen pa rnam pa gsum po ste rgyu dang*/ nyams su len byed kyi thabs ni sbyor ba bzhi'i bdag nyid dang*/ nyams su blangs pas thob pa ni chos sku phrin las dang bcas pa'i 'bras bu dang bcas pa yin la/ ni ni nges gzung gi don to/ /de ltar yum gyi don kun bsdus tshul snga ma las gzhan 'di lta bu'i rnam pa gsum yang yod do// gsum pa bshad pa mthar phyin pa'i tshul la gnyis/ rdzogs tshig smos pa dang*/ 'gyur byang bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba'i tshig le'ur byas pa rdzogs so// //zhes gsungs te/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba'i tshig le'ur byas pa/ rje btsun byams pa mgon pos mdzad pa rdzogs so// //gnyis pa 'gyur byang bstan pa ni/ paṇ+ḍi ta go mi 'chi med dang*/ lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyis bsgyur/ zhes gsungs te/ paṇ+ḍi ta dpal go mi 'chi med la sogs pa dang*/ lo tsā ba chen po dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus chen gyi sgo nas legs par gtan la phab par mdzad pa'o//

//rje btsun ngal gso'i rtsa ba'i tshig 'grel nyid//rang bzos bcos bslad med par bkod pa la//nyes bshad 'byung ba'i go skabs bral ba'i phyir//blo gros gsar bus 'di nyid sbyang bar gces//'on kyang rang lugs zab gnad rtogs dgos phyir//bsdus 'grel tsam gyis 'tshengs nas mi bzhugs par// rgyas 'grel nyid la sbyang pa mthar phyin nas//shes rab gsum gyi snang ba rgyas par mdzod//ces rgyal mchog bcu drug pa chen po'i thugs bskyed dang phrin las kyi stobs las/ shrī na lan+d+ra yi bshad grwa gsar 'dzug gnang ba'i skabs/ phran khra 'gu sprul ming pas/ rje brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i sher phyin rgyas 'grel rje btsun ngal gso'i steng nas dpe khrid phul skabs/ slob phrug las dang po pa glegs bam mjal bas spobs pa zhum pa rnams la phan pa'i ched/ tshig 'grel tsam zur du bkol ba'i skabs/ skyabs rje dpon slob rin po che mchog gis/ phyag bris 'bad brtson dang rogs ram gnang nas yongs su grub pa 'dis bstan pa rgyas shing 'gro kun bde ba'i rgyur gyur cig/

sher phyin mngon rtogs rgyan gyi tshig 'grel zur bkol gyi sa bcad/ ka nyon par byed pa'i sgo gsum/ 1 kha rnam grangs bcu gcig 2 ga yum sras bcu bdun/ 2 nga rgya 'grel nyi shu rtsa gcig 2 ca sher phyin bod du dar tshul/ 1 bstan pa snga dar la dar tshul/ 3 2 bstan pa phyi dar la dar tshul/ 4 cha sher phyin dang gzhung lam sher phyin gyi mtshan nyid/ 5 sher phyin mngon rtogs rgyan gyi dgongs pa rje btsun mi bskyod rdo rjes bkral ba bsdus te 'chad pa la gsum/ 1 bstan bcos 'chad pa la 'jug pa'i yan lag 6 2 yan lag can gyi bstan bcos dngos/ 7 3 bshad pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i yan lag mjug gi don no// 188 dang po bstan bcos 'chad pa la 'jug pa'i yan lag la gnyis/ 1 mtshan gyi don/ 6 2 'gyur gyi phyag go/ 7 dang po mtshan gyi don la gnyis/ 1 mtshan bsgyur cing zhar la dka' gnad 'ga' zhig bshad pa dang*/ 6 2 btags pa'i dgos pa'o// 7 gnyis pa yan lag can gyi bstan bcos dngos la gsum/ 1 rang nyid bstan bcos rtsom pa la 'jug pa'i yan lag tu mchod brjod/ 7 2 brtsams pa'i bstan bcos la gzhan 'jug pa dgos 'brel/ 11 3 'jug bya bstan bcos kyi brjod bya mngon rtogs nyid bshad pa'o// 13 gsum pa 'jug bya bstan bcos kyi brjod bya mngon rtogs nyid bshad pa la gsum/ 1 rgyas pa la mos pa'i gang zag la brgyad du phye ste bshad pa/ 13 2 bar pa la mos pa'i gang zag la don drug tu bstan pa/ 187 3 bsdus pa la mos pa'i gang zag la don gsum du bsdus te bstan pa'o// 187 dang po rgyas pa la mos pa'i gang zag la brgyad du phye ste bshad pa la gnyis/ 1 lus rnam par bzhag pa dang*/ 13 2 yan lag rgyas par bshad pa'o// 23 dang po lus rnam par bzhag pa la gnyis/ 1 mdor bstan pa dang*/ 13 2 rgyas par dbye ba'o// 16 skabs dang po/ rnam mkhyen/ gnyis pa yan lag rgyas par bshad pa la gsum/ 1 yul mkhyen gsum/ 23 2 thabs sbyor bzhi/ 93 3 'bras bu chos sku bshad pa'o// 167 dang po yul mkhyen gsum la gsum/
